title: 风暴领域 Storm Domain
body:
关联神祇：寇德 Kord

As an initiate of the storm god, you learn to invoke prayers that draw howling winds and lashing storms from the Astral Sea into the mortal realm. The storm is a force of raw destruction that brings its power to bear upon those that lack shelter.

**1级：风暴领域特性和威能 Storm Domain Features and Powers**

Your prayers allow you to hammer your foes with the destructive power of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning. However, the power of the storm god also allows you to shelter yourself and your allies from harm.

**增益：**你获得5点闪电抗力和5点雷鸣抗力。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，目标同时在他下一回合结束之前的下一次伤害骰上获得+2威能加值。11级时此加值为+4，21级时此加值为+6

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your blessing grants a measure of moral strength. In battle, it offers the raw power to smite enemies.

⟦神怒祝福 Blessing of Wrath⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your dedication to the storm god puts the power of thunder and lightning into your hands. The storm grants you strength and shows you how to strike with unmatched speed and fury.

⟦风暴之锤 Storm Hammer⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

In the aftermath of the storm comes the gentle rain that sustains life and can keep you and your allies alive in the harshest environments.

⟦造水术 Create Water⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

As a storm warpriest, one of the first prayers you learn allows you to focus the power of the divine storm into your melee attack. Your weapon rumbles with energy, shivering in your hand as if it cannot wait to unleash its fury upon your foes.

⟦雷鸣武器 Thundering Steel⟧

**1级：引导神力（风暴领域） Channel Divinity (Storm)**

Any enemies that see your power learn to keep their distance from you. They cannot escape your wrath, though, for you can channel the power of the storm into one of your companions, who can then unleash a pulse of lightning in a deadly weapon attack.

⟦风暴潮 Storm Surge⟧

**3级：风暴领域遭遇威能 Storm Domain Encounter Power**

You are able to humble an enemy that takes too much pride in physical strength. At your command, you open a rift to the howling winds of the Astral Sea. The winds buffet your foe with a deadly attack that leaves it on the ground.

⟦锤击风暴 Hammering Wind⟧

**5级：风暴领域特性 Storm Domain Features**

The wrath of a thunderstorm roils within your soul. Even when you take time to heal your allies, your enemies feel the fearsome energy within you.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，你选择的一个邻近此威能目标的敌人受到等同于你体质调整值的雷鸣伤害

**7级：风暴领域遭遇威能 Storm Domain Encounter Power**

You call upon the winds of the storm to bear your weapon forth to smash your enemies. As your god's lightning strikes, divine winds carry you forward to press your attack. Clerics of the storm use this attack to charge their enemies or to pursue those that flee.

⟦狂怒闪电 Wrathful Lightning⟧

**10级：风暴领域特性 Storm Domain Features**

As you channel the divine storm, you draw vigor from its power. As you unleash each attack, the divine magic you command fortifies you to continue the fight.

**增益：**当你使用带有雷鸣关键字的神术遭遇攻击威能时，你获得等同于2 + 你体质调整值的临时生命值

**11级：虔诚行动（风暴领域） Devout Action (Storm)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

The power of the storm infuses your soul. When you become angry, thunder rumbles in the distance. When you are calm or contented, the wind abates and even the heaviest rain feels like a gentle caress. When your enemies force you to unleash your full threat in combat, potent divine magic imbues your attack with thundering might.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在你下一回合结束前，下一个你以神术攻击威能命中的生物晕眩，直到它下一回合结束。

**11级：至高祝福（风暴领域） Transcendent Blessing (Storm)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

As your divine strength increases at the paragon tier, so too does the might of the storm that you gather against your enemies.

**增益：**当你使用⟦风暴之锤 Storm Hammer⟧时，你同时推离目标最多2格

**12级：风暴领域辅助威能 Storm Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

In one of the final battles of the Dawn War, the primordials waited in a deadly ambush, hoping to dispatch the gods once and for all. The gods escaped, though, using a great planar storm to carry them away and shield them until they could ready a counterattack. By drawing on the remnant energy of that storm, you can lift your allies into more advantageous positions on the battlefield.

⟦胜利之风 Winds of Victory⟧

**13级：风暴领域遭遇威能 Storm Domain Encounter Power**

For a brief moment, you imbue your weapon with the power of the storm god's most dread attack. By targeting a powerful melee combatant, your roar of thunder gives you and your allies a chance to take that foe out before its full wrath can be unleashed.

⟦雷鸣咆哮 Roar of Thunder⟧

**16级：风暴领域特性 Storm Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your link to the Astral Sea is such that even your signature healing prayer is imbued with the energy of the divine storms that sweep across that plane.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，你可以滑动你自己或威能爆发范围内的一个盟友最多等同于你体质调整值的格数

**17级：风暴领域遭遇威能 Storm Domain Encounter Power**

As the storm god's servant, you channel power to draw forth a furious wind that you control with absolute precision. Sweeping your allies out of harm's way, you unleash the full force of the storm against your foes.

⟦狂暴之风 Winds of Fury⟧

**20级：风暴领域每日威能 Storm Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

It is one thing to wield the power of divine storms with your prayers. It is another to unleash the might of the storm god within yourself. At the apex of the paragon tier, you become an avatar of the storm, capable of unleashing thunder against your foes for extended periods.

⟦风暴之怒 Storm's Fury⟧

**23级：风暴领域遭遇威能 Storm Domain Encounter Power**

In the epic tier, you draw upon storm magic so powerful that it can rend the bindings between the planes. You imbue this magic into your weapon. As you hurl it at your foe, your weapon cleaves through the planes and pulls you and your allies through space to press the assault.

⟦公正雷鸣 Thunder of Justice⟧

**27级：风暴领域遭遇威能 Storm Domain Encounter Power**

When the final battles raged between the gods and the primordials, the storm god invoked a brutal astral tempest. Nearing the height of the epic tier, you stand as close to the gods as any mortal ever has. You can tap into the lingering power of the gods’ greatest triumph, claiming some of the storm’s might.

⟦首战惊雷 Thunder of the Dawn War⟧

title: 幻术学派 Illusion School
body:
Spells of the illusion school deceive the mind and confuse the senses. A master of illusion uses arcane magic to build on a natural talent for trickery, and knows that the timing of an illusion is often as important as its power.

**1级：幻术学徒 Illusion Apprentice**

**学徒级学派法师特性**

Any mage can make use of illusion magic, but your specific focus lends potency to the spells you cast. A creature caught up in your illusion remains rattled even after the magic is done, unable to focus past its terror or confusion as it makes its counterattack.

**增益：**当你以一个奥术幻术威能命中一个目标时，在你下一回合结束前此目标在它下一次对你的攻击骰上受到-2减值

**5级：幻术专家 Illusion Expert**

**专家级学派法师特性**

As a specialist in illusion magic, you subtly channel the power of your art to cloak your own movements and intentions.

**增益：**你在唬骗检定和隐秘检定上获得+2加值

**10级：幻术大师 Illusion Master**

**大师级学派法师特性**

As you near the end of the heroic tier, your illusions take on a deadly realism that rattles your foes. Even an enemy that sees through your deception is wracked by doubt and fear that ruins its defenses for a critical moment.

**增益：**当你的一个奥术幻术威能对一个目标命中或失手时，在你下回合结束前，目标给下一次对它进行的攻击提供战斗优势。

**11级：幻术行动 Illusion Action**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Those who dismiss illusion magic for its ephemeral quality fail to understand the very real strength it lends you. When you push yourself past your limits, a shroud of light and shadow protects you from your enemies' attacks.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在AC和反射上获得等同于你感知调整值的威能加值，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：幻术遭遇威能 Illusion Encounter Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

The legendary wizard Nolzur was obsessed with formulating illusion spells capable of creating tangible effects and objects that would persist in the real world. This spell was the first step in his research, channeling illusion magic to recreate the eff ects of other spells.

⟦诺尔祖之影法术 Nolzur's Shade Spell⟧

**12级：幻术辅助威能 Illusion Utility Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

The power of divine magic to mend wounds and banish disease fascinated Nolzur. He created this spell in an attempt to prove that his arcane illusions could mimic even the most potent effects of other magic, creating a useful alternative to the healing of other classes.

⟦诺尔祖之虚幻活力术 Nolzur's Phantom Vigor⟧

**20级：幻术每日威能 Illusion Daily Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Nolzur eventually found other challenges to distract him from his quest to duplicate magic of any sort using the power of illusion. However, this spell confirms the lasting legacy of that research, and is the most potent part of many an illusion mage's spell arsenal.

⟦诺尔祖之幻影法术 Nolzur's Phantom Spell⟧

title: 混沌滑翔艇 Chaos Glider
body:
**混沌滑翔艇 Chaos Glider**

巨型 载具

**生命值** 100；**空间** 2格×3格；**花费** 13,000gp

**AC** 4，**强韧** 12，**反射** 4

**速度** 飞行10

**驾驶员**

驾驶员必须以双手控制混沌滑翔艇的双翼

**工作人员**

除了驾驶员，混沌滑翔艇还需要4个工作人员，他们所有人每轮都需要使用一个标准动作来帮助控制此载具。每少一个工作人员，此载具的速度就减少4。飞行速度为0时，则此载具失控飞行

**负载**

6个中型生物；100磅的货物

**失控**

失控的混沌滑翔艇会以半速沿随机方向移动

**混沌推进力**

混沌滑翔艇乘驾着流经元素混沌的混沌能量流，故仅在此位面生效。其推进力充其量也只能算是不确定的。其上的乘客可能会有时遭遇停滞，被抛至未知之地，抑或眨眼间疾驰抵赴目的地。平均而言，滑翔艇可以其标注的速度行进。

title: 混沌舰船 Chaos Ship
body:
**混沌舰船 Chaos Ship**

极巨型 载具

**生命值** 2,00；**空间** 27格×16格；**花费** n/a

**AC** 3，**强韧** 20，**反射** 2

**免疫** 闪电

**速度** 飞行12（盘旋），长距飞行15

**驾驶员**

驾驶员必须站在艉楼甲板上的舵轮处。舵轮安装在万向杠杆上，用以控制俯仰与高度。甲板下方延伸的缆索连接着三个混沌球悬架。这些混沌球提供动力与升力。舰船可在无驾驶员或工作人员时悬浮，但前进需二者兼备

**工作人员**

除了驾驶员，混沌舰船还需要3个工作人员来进行除了悬浮之外的移动。每个工作人员必须就位于三个内嵌混沌球的邻近位置。一旦混沌舰船开始航行，每个工作人员每轮都需要使用一个标准动作来帮助控制此载具。每少一个工作人员，此载具的速度就减少4。若此载具在它航行之后的任意轮中飞行速度变为0，则此载具无法操控且失控飞行。一旦此载具失控，恢复控制需要驾驶员和3个工作人员连续3轮保持就位

**负载**

200个中型生物；4,000吨的货物

**失控**

当此舰船失控时，它以半速向前移动。每轮掷一个d20。若结果为1-5，则此舰船下降。它在失控的前10轮内，每轮下降5格。在10轮之后，它每轮下降10格。如果它在失控航行超过20轮后，撞上元素混沌或无底深渊的固体微尘，则它损毁

**混沌调和**

混沌舰船只能在元素混沌和无底深渊中运作

**舵轮和三个混沌球（导航器材）**

此载具配备了三个混沌球，它们是艉楼甲板上的舵轮的导航器材

title: 惑控学派 Enchantment School
body:
The enchantment school of magic centers on the study of charms and other spells that change a creature's attitudes and perceptions. Specialization in enchantment magic allows you to exercise powerful and precise control over your enemies, even to the point where they attack with a fanatic's fury at your command.

**1级：惑控学徒 Enchantment Apprentice**

**学徒级学派法师特性**

By focusing on the study of enchantment magic, you learn to achieve more control over your enemies.

**增益：**当你的一个奥术惑控威能允许你拉近、推离、滑动一个生物时，此被迫移动的最大距离增加2格

**5级：惑控专家 Enchantment Expert**

**专家级学派法师特性**

Your study of enchantment gives you the ability to inflect your words with magic, enhancing your powers of persuasion.

**增益：**你在唬骗检定和交涉检定上获得+2加值

**10级：惑控大师 Enchantment Master**

**大师级学派法师特性**

As you master the initial secrets of enchantment magic, you learn to invoke a deadly rage in the minds you manipulate.

**增益：**当你的一个奥术惑控威能迫使一个生物进行一次攻击时，此生物在此攻击骰上获得+2加值

**11级：惑控行动 Enchantment Action**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

When you push yourself beyond your normal limits, the magic of the Feywild swirls around you. Your enemies become caught in a web of enchantment for a brief moment, causing them to stumble and move as if in a dream.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你滑动离你2格内的每个敌人最多等同于你魅力调整值的格数

**11级：惑控遭遇威能 Enchantment Encounter Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

The legendary wizard Otto made a career of melding music and arcane spellcraft. This spell creates a discordant tune that echoes through a victim's mind, forcing it to do your bidding. Moreover, even after your control is broken, the victim is unable to fully react—a prime target for you and your allies.

⟦奥托之扭曲术 Otto's Twisting Tune⟧

**12级：惑控辅助威能 Enchantment Utility Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Otto was a thoroughly capricious individual, and he was not above making friends and new allies with the help of this signature spell. More than one of Otto's many apprentices recalls being suddenly inspired to undertake some mischievous (though rarely dangerous) task on the wizard's behalf.

⟦奥托之忠诚歌唱术 Otto's Song of Fidelity⟧

**20级：惑控每日威能 Enchantment Daily Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Otto found that certain strains of music consistently inspired a physical response. This spell builds on that principle, creating a wave of dominating magic that inevitably crumbles a victim's resolve. Each time a creature shrugs off your attempt to control it, your song of command becomes more insistent in response.

⟦奥托之绝对命令术 Otto's Inevitable Command⟧

title: 精类契约 Fey Pact
body:
The lords of the Feywild grant power to mortals for a variety of reasons. Some do so out of a sense of twisted mirth, because they enjoy granting great power to those without the maturity or sense to use it wisely. Others court mortal champions who can protect the fey realms and hold back the rising tide of evil.

**1级：精类契约奖励 Fey Pact Reward**

As a fey pact hexblade, you learn to channel your natural agility into your magical and physical attacks, enhancing their deadliness.

**增益：**你在你的邪术师攻击威能和邪术师典范之道攻击威能的伤害骰上获得等同于你敏捷调整值的加值。5级时，此加值为2 + 你敏捷调整值；15级时，此加值为4 + 你敏捷调整值；25级时，此加值为6 + 你敏捷调整值。

9级时，你以⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤的生物也在伤害骰上获得此加值

**1级：精类契约之赐 Fey Pact Boon**

The lords of the Feywild practice magic that bends and twists the planes. In that realm, a step through a dense thicket can cover hundreds of miles as mortals reckon distances. With this boon, you transform into a being of wind and clouds, allowing you to leap through space.

**增益：**你获得⟦灵魂步伐 Soul Step⟧威能

**1级：精类契约武器 Fey Pact Weapon**

The blade of winter's mourning is a gift from the fey lords of winter, ice, and snow. It is made from a strange, blue metal that delivers lethal wounds. Because of its supernatural origin, it is lighter and easier to handle than a mundane weapon.

The blade reflects the elegant fighting style of the rakes and bravos who haunt wintry fey citadels. A rapier of living metal, the blade shifts and moves of its own accord to aid you in battle. It twists to parry attacks, and with its ability to hinder your enemy's counterattack, you can dart in, deliver an attack, and move away.

当你获得此武器时，你同时获得在持用该武器时能使用的2个威能，⟦冰刺击 Icy Skewer⟧和⟦穿刺碎片 Piercing Shard⟧

冬哀之刃 Blade of Winter's Mourning邪术师装备

This rapier seems to quiver and hum with its own power, its steel covered with a patina of frost.

    **武器分类：**
    单手军用近战武器

    **武器组：**
    轻刃

    **擅长加值：**
    +3

    **伤害：**
    1d10

⟦冰刺击 Icy Skewer⟧

⟦穿刺碎片 Piercing Shard⟧

**1级：精类契约武器 Fey Pact Weapon（Dragon #393）**

You have sought out the lady of the White Well and impressed her enough to earn her favor. She entrusts you with a charge: fight in her name and for her honor. How you acquit yourself in your quests will determine whether you can one day claim the ultimate prize.

The sword of the White Well was the noble blade used by the fey knight who fathered the lady. When he learned how he had been used by lolth, the knight hurled the weapon into the well and vowed to never fight again. Thus the weapon symbolizes the tragic circumstances of the lady's birth while also representing the gift of magic she bestows to champions who have the best chance at winning her heart.

The weapon possesses perfect balance and adjusts its length and weight to its wielder. While not as accurate as those weapons favored in the eladrin courts, it compensates by delivering devastating wounds wherever it strikes.

On gaining the sword, you also learn two spells to unlock its magical power. Moonfire blade transforms the weapon into radiant moonlight to help your strikes slip through armor and other defenses unobstructed. When enemies loom on all sides, you can use well of light to call forth the lady's power in a shining beacon.

**增益：**你可选择此特性来替换通常的「精类契约武器」特性

白井之剑 Sword of the White Well邪术师装备

The sword's slim, pale blade shines as if bathed in moonlight.

    **武器分类：**
    单手军用近战武器

    **武器组：**
    重刃

    **擅长加值：**
    +2

    **伤害：**
    1d12

⟦月火之刃 Moonfire Blade⟧

⟦光之源泉 Well of Light⟧

**7级：精类契约武器惩戒 Fey Pact Weapon Retribution**

When an enemy dares attack you, you call on the fury of the winter court, manifesting it within your blade as you punish the offender.

**增益：**你获得⟦冬之惩戒脱离 Winter's Retributive Escape⟧威能

**7级：精类契约武器惩戒 Fey Pact Weapon Retribution（Dragon #393）**

The lady intercedes on your behalf when you come into danger and bathes you in her radiance to spare you from harm.

**增益：**你可选择此特性来替换通常的「精类契约武器惩戒」特性

你获得⟦月光脱离 Moonlit Escape⟧威能

**9级：召唤邪术师盟友（精类契约） Summon Warlock's Ally (Fey)**

A humanoid creature with woodlike flesh and bearing a heavy, gnarled club answers your summons to serve as a temporary bodyguard at the behest of your fey allies. The wood woad guardian is slow but tough, its thick hide allowing it to absorb attacks. It is a faithful protector, loyally taking attacks meant for you.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦菘蓝守卫 Wood Woad Guardian⟧

⟦菘蓝守卫 Wood Woad Guardian⟧

**9级：召唤邪术师盟友（精类契约） Summon Warlock's Ally (Fey)（Dragon #393）**

During the first years of the lady's exile, several handmaidens stayed with her, offering companionship and sympathy. As these handmaidens died, the lady sustained them in undeath and sometimes sends these servants to aid her champions.

The handmaiden appears in soft, white light. She is an achingly beautiful eladrin, yet strange in her bearing and manner. She is armed with a slim, white sword and ready to fight at your side.

**增益：**你可选择此特性来替换通常的「召唤邪术师盟友」特性

如果你有「白井之剑」，则你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦哀悼侍女 Mourning Handmaiden⟧

⟦哀悼侍女 Mourning Handmaiden⟧

**11级：魔剑士行动（精类契约） Hexblade's Action (Fey)**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

As you enter the paragon tier, you are able to better access the magic of the fey through your pact. With practice, you learn to slide into the fey realm and travel a short distance, appearing elsewhere in the blink of an eye.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在此额外动作之前或之后，你能以一个自由动作成为隐形并传送最多等同于你敏捷调整值的格数。你保持隐形直到你下一回合开始

**11级：精类契约面貌 Fey Pact Aspect**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Your mastery of fey magic lends arcane credence to your lies and unmatched speed to your feet.

**增益：**你在唬骗检定上获得+2加值，且在速度上获得+1加值

**11级：精类契约诅咒 Fey Pact Curse**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You call on the power of the Feywild, directing the verdant growth inherent in that realm to infest your enemy. Leaves and vines quickly take root in your foe, leaving it open to attack.

⟦碎甲诅咒 Curse of Shattered Armor⟧

**12级：精类契约祈祷 Fey Pact Invocation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

With this spell, you appeal to the lords of the Feywild to aid you with good fortune in your battles—a sudden gust of wind knocks aside an arrow certain to hit you, or an enemy stumbles on a tree root before it can bring its axe crashing down upon you. However, the fey lords are fickle creatures. Just as they offer good fortune, their moods can suddenly change and curse you with ill luck.

⟦精类祈祷 Fey Invocation⟧

**16级：进阶精类契约之赐 Improved Fey Pact Boon**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Your initial understanding of your fey pact allowed you to move among the fabric of the planes, disappearing in one spot and appearing elsewhere in the blink of an eye. With experience, you now know how to draw more deeply on the Feywild's magic. When you teleport, the magic lingers, cloaking you in invisibility.

**增益：**当你使用⟦灵魂步伐 Soul Step⟧时，你对你的敌人处于隐形直到你下一回合结束

**20级：精类契约变形 Fey Pact Transformation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You draw the magic of the Feywild into yourself and use it to warp the world around you. By twisting the planes, you can teleport with a single step, while your flickering, misty image makes it difficult for foes to attack you. At your command, this magic swirls around you, wracking your foes' minds and leaving them blind to your presence.

⟦精类变形 Feywild Transformation⟧

**25级：高阶召唤邪术师盟友（精类契约） Greater Summon Warlock's Ally (Fey)**

Drawn from the cold regions of the Feywild, a frostblight treant serves as an implacable guardian. The fey lords of the icy reaches command the treants to stand in long ranks amid the mundane trees of their forest realms, crushing invaders with their gnarled limbs and rooting them in place with blasts of cold and ice.

Away from its icy home, a summoned frostblight treant has only a fraction of the power that it normally possesses. It freezes enemies in place with its icy roots, protects you with craggy limbs, and can draw the vitality out of your foes.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦枯霜树人守护者 Frostblight Treant Protector⟧

⟦枯霜树人守护者 Frostblight Treant Protector⟧

**25级：高阶召唤邪术师盟友（精类契约） Greater Summon Warlock's Ally (Fey)（Dragon #393）**

The knight who fell to lolth's treachery so long ago lingers as a watchful and protective spirit over his daughter. Although the knight vowed never to bear arms and don armor after his disgrace, he safeguards his offspring from harm by using the Feywild's magic.

The lady's favor rewards you with a fragment of the knight's essence to fight at your side. The doomed knight unleashes all the grief brought on by his fall and withers your enemies' resolve to fight.

**增益：**你可选择此特性来替换通常的「高阶召唤邪术师盟友」特性

你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦幽灵守护者 Spectral Protector⟧

⟦幽灵守护者 Spectral Protector⟧

title: 精类契约 Fey Pact (Binder)
body:
While many tales of the Feywild make it seem like a whimsical land of enchantment, anyone with planar experience knows that, as with the world of men, there is a dark side to the realm of the fey. Sinister fey creatures, agents of the Unseelie, lurk in the shadows of forests and wait for passing prey. The most powerful of these creatures extend their reach beyond their own realm, tempting and warping the minds of mortals.

Fey pact binders are a means by which dark fey extend their grasp outside of the Feywild. Binders who form pacts with these powerful Unseelie wield shadow-tainted arcane magic, reflecting the dark, corrupted natures of the fey creatures they serve. Many binders have learned not just how to coax knowledge out of these dark fey creatures, but how to become one of them; the unwary fey pact binder is often corrupted by the same malevolence that empowers his or her benefactor.

Alternatively, your fey pact binder might be a dark fey that has taken on the guise of one of the friendlier races, openly using knowledge of Unseelie power while disguising his or her true nature. Such an elaborate disguise often requires the dark fey to actually transform into one of the mortal races; more than just a disguise, the mortal body is a prison in which the power of the dark fey resides.

**1级：精类契约之赐（缚影师） Fey Pact Boon (Binder)**

Some of the first tricks that a fey pact binder masters include how to cloud sight and how to create distractions out of pure shadow. The nature of the power that a binder draws from fey creatures often necessitates luring enemies in close before landing a final strike; a cautious binder learns techniques to keep these lured enemies from inflicting too much harm.

**增益：**你获得⟦障目之云 Cloud Sight⟧和⟦迷魂暗影 Fascinating Shadows⟧威能

**1级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

Not all of the dark fey in the Feywild are large, powerful creatures. Among the most dangerous are swarms of tiny sprites that can set upon an unwary traveler, bringing a painful death by a thousand cuts. The binder can summon and command a whirlwind of these vicious sprites and watch as they rend the binder‘s enemies with tiny claws, teeth, and makeshift weapons tipped in painful poisons.

⟦精灵潜袭 Unseelie Sprites⟧

**3级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

A binder that draws power from the fey quickly learns how to sow confusion among his or her enemies. With the proper application of shadow magic, the mind of a weak enemy can be bent so that they see friends as enemies and enemies as friends. However, those who have their minds clouded in this way often emerge from their shadowy haze to find that they have attacked their own allies.

⟦忠诚诱惑 Lure of Loyalty⟧

**4级：精类契约学识 Fey Pact Lore**

As a result of an ongoing association with a powerful fey creature, the binder learns to weave permanent wards over his or her own body to fend off attacks. Similarly, the binder's mind is so accustomed to the mind-clouding effects of dark fey magic that it becomes inured to such effects.

**增益：**你在AC和意志上获得+1加值

**7级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

Though many might dismiss tales of men being enchanted by a fey song or by the whispers of a dryad, there is one warning from those tales that all travelers in the Feywild know: never let a creature touch you, for that is the surest way for a capricious fey to make you its slave. The binder masters the magic that makes this possible, and by laying a hand on a foe that gets too close, a warlock can make that enemy into a slave for a short time.

⟦控制之触 Touch of Command⟧

**9级：缚影师盟友（精类契约） Binder's Ally (Fey)**

A powerful Unseelie patron might be convinced to loan a binder one of its retainers. Among the most common servants of the dark fey are creatures known as satyrs of the night. These satyrs were once just like their Feywild brethren—jovial, carefree, and tricksy. But these satyrs were seduced by the shadowy power of the binder's fey patron and were slowly corrupted into twisted, cruel versions of their former selves.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦夜魔 Satyr of the Night⟧

⟦夜魔 Satyr of the Night⟧

**11级：缚影师行动（精类契约） Binder's Action (Fey)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

Shadow magic infuses the arcane power that fuels your spells, seeping through from your dark patron's own corruption. When you exert yourself, your ability to wield that shadow magic clouds the mind of your enemy.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外攻击时，你以此攻击命中的一个敌人晕眩直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：缚影师恩惠（精类契约） Binder's Favor (Fey)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

Whenever you draw upon the corrupted magic of your Unseelie patron, shadows now seem to form over the eyes of those whom you strike.

**增益：**当你以⟦迷魂暗影 Fascinating Shadows⟧命中一个敌人时，你的盟友对该敌人具有隐蔽直到你下一回合结束

**11级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

In the deepest, blackest hearts of Feywild forests, there grows a plant. This plant exudes a poison that fills the minds of living beings with terror. You have wheedled the knowledge of this plant out of the dark fey, and can create a facsimile of its vines out of pure shadow.

⟦梦魇毒藤 Nightmare Vines⟧

**13级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

Those who live in cities in the mortal realm, far from fey crossings or forests with a strong fey presence, rarely believe the stories of strong-willed men lured into danger by a dryad's sweet song. You have drawn the knowledge of such magic out of your fey patron, learning to combine that seductive song with other spells. You lure your enemies close to you, then vanish and flit away, leaving them grouped together and vulnerable to your allies' attacks.

⟦神行呼叫 Fleeting Call⟧

**16级：缚影师之赐（精类契约） Binder's Boon (Fey)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

Your ability to manipulate the will of your enemies does more than blind them to the threat you pose; it muddles their senses to the point that they have a hard time putting up a defense against your allies.

**增益：**当你使用⟦障目之云 Cloud Sight⟧时，此威能的目标同时提供战斗优势直到你下一回合结束

**17级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

As you grow more and more like your fey patron, filled with Unseelie magic and knowledge both dangerous and arcane, you learn to focus your abilities on a single enemy and bend its will to your needs. You make that enemy your faithful servant, ensuring that it turns upon its own allies rather than see you come to harm.

⟦海妖之歌 Song of the Siren⟧

**23级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

Those who are foolish enough to approach you quickly find themselves under your thrall. You are now as much of an Unseelie force as your fey patron, and any who get close enough for you to lay a hand on them quickly turn to strike their own allies.

⟦不甘背叛 Unwilling Betrayal⟧

**25级：高阶缚影师盟友（精类契约） Greater Binder's Ally (Fey)**

A status symbol among many eladrin noble houses and a valued servant among all fey creatures, the displacer beast is a dangerous creature that reflects the predatory and deceptive aspects of the Feywild. Your power has grown to the extent that you can reach into the Feywild and summon one of these creatures. Upon its arrival, it obeys your commands, sensing the Unseelie magic you wield.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦位移兽 Displacer Beast⟧

⟦位移兽 Displacer Beast⟧

**27级：精类契约遭遇威能 Fey Pact Encounter Power**

Even the most shadow-tainted of fey creatures retains some of the Feywild's beauty and charm. Your fey patron wants the same adoration and devotion as any other fey lord. But where many members of the Court of Stars offer protection and generosity in return for the supplication of their subjects, your patron sees lesser creatures as worms that should grovel at its feet or be crushed under its boot, should the whim strike. You can tap into this drive and force your enemies to kneel before you as they writhe in the terrible beauty and delicious agony of your presence. This devotion briefly lingers, even after you depart.

⟦蠕虫之愿 Supplication of the Worms⟧

title: 科瑞隆领域 Corellon Domain
body:
关联神祇：（都是费伦神祇）科瑞隆 Corellon，安格芮丝 Angharradh

Corellon's clerics serve as his feywardens—characters whose solemn duty is the protection of the traditions and works of the elf race. However, Corellon stands for much more than just the guardianship of his people. He leads the pantheon of elven deities as the epitome of elven magic, music, arts, crafts, poetry, and warfare. Corellon's warpriests follow his example, becoming experts in the arts of creativity, war, and magic. They must not only protect the elves and their culture, but must promote and spread the greatness of that culture.

**1级：科瑞隆领域特性和威能 Corellon Domain Features and Powers**

The reconnection of the world with the Feywild brought the elves of Abeir-Toril into contact with kin they had thought lost in ages past. The long-dormant powers this contact awakened among the elves of both planes shows Corellon's desire for his folk to become a united people. Reinvigorated by this union, the elves of Faerûn have gone from a race in decline to one of great strength. However, as with any great people, wars both threaten and ennoble them.

Corellon acts as the elven god of war, and as such, he arms his warpriests with traditional elven weapons and with powers that enhance the strengths of their race. A warpriest of Corellon can be expected to fight ably with sword or bow, and to freely channel Corellon's divine might.

**增益：**当你受到一个可豁免终止的魅惑效果影响时，你能在你的每个回合开始时对此效果进行一次豁免检定，回合结束时也一样可进行豁免。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，你和爆发范围内的每个盟友在快步时可无视困难地形，直到你下一回合开始

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Corellon calls on all elves to revere the beauty of nature. Even in war, his people must attempt to refrain from upsetting or destroying the natural world. To remind his warpriests of this duty, Corellon puts them in touch with their wild spirit.

⟦野性祝福 Blessing of the Wild⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your use of bow and blade is so fluid that you can exchange one for the other before a foe can react.

⟦优雅转换 Graceful Switch⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

You serve as a guardian of your people, but you need not stand alone. With divine aid, you can grant to both yourself and others the acute senses shared by many fey.

⟦妖精视觉 Fey Sight⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

Eerie energy infuses the Feywild, flowing through your connection to Corellon. With a short prayer, you can invoke a supernatural element of that mysterious realm to enhance your weapon.

**1级：引导神力（科瑞隆领域） Channel Divinity (Corellon)**

Corellon's warpriests serve by leading the charge and by giving succor to the wounded when the battle is done. To aid them in this endeavor, they learn to carry an ally to safety even in the heat of battle.

⟦一致步调 Step Together⟧

**3级：科瑞隆领域遭遇威能 Corellon Domain Encounter Power**

Elves are rightly legendary for the accuracy of their weapon attacks. With Corellon's help, you can lend that accuracy to an ally.

⟦精准联合 Allied Accuracy⟧

**5级：科瑞隆领域特性 Corellon Domain Features**

As you continue in your devotion to Corellon, more of his magic becomes open to you. When you call on his aid for healing, he grants you a means of slipping past foes unscathed.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标能以一个自由动作快步1格。如果目标是精灵，半精灵或雅灵，则改为目标快步最多等同于你体质调整值的格数

**7级：科瑞隆领域遭遇威能 Corellon Domain Encounter Power**

Corellon is a god not just of elves but of all fey, including the mysterious and beguiling unicorns. Utilizing a measure of their power, you thwart your enemies’ attacks.

⟦精灵迷魂 Fey Beguiling⟧

**10级：科瑞隆领域特性 Corellon Domain Features**

Your channeling of Corellon's magic opens pathways that no one else can see.

**增益：**当你使用带有力场或光耀关键字的神术遭遇攻击威能时，你能以一个自由动作传送1格

**11级：虔诚行动（科瑞隆领域） Devout Action (Corellon)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Corellon's grace flows through you, lending a swiftness to your actions when you push yourself to the limit.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你能移动此额外动作允许的2倍距离。

**11级：至高祝福（科瑞隆领域） Transcendent Blessing (Corellon)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

By adding a flourish to one of your domain abilities, you can strike your foe in such a way that you open up an easier attack for one of your friends.

**增益：**当你以⟦优雅转换 Graceful Switch⟧命中一个目标时，选择离你5格内的一个盟友。在你下一回合结束前，该盟友的下一次对此目标的攻击获得战斗优势

**12级：科瑞隆领域辅助威能 Corellon Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

The elves' fondness for nature extends far beyond the gentle deer and the fleet hare. The savage hunters of the wilderness are also honored and emulated. A prayer to Corellon can grant you and your allies the stealth and speed of a hunting pack of wolves.

⟦精灵之佑 Blessing of Elvenkind⟧

**13级：科瑞隆领域遭遇威能 Corellon Domain Encounter Power**

Though some elves are less virtuous than others, all of them represent lights in a dark world. Your own virtue marks you as one of the brightest in the elven host, and with glimmer strike, you bring that metaphor to life, striking out against the darkness in your foes.

⟦闪亮打击 Glimmer Strike⟧

**16级：科瑞隆领域特性 Corellon Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your healing magic envelops the target in a shroud of sparkling motes, and when they dissipate your ally appears to be gone. Enemies will find it hard to strike what they cannot see.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标对敌人隐形直到他下一回合开始

**17级：科瑞隆领域遭遇威能 Corellon Domain Encounter Power**

Art and music should be just as important to you as battle, if not more so. Corellon reminds you of this by using the force of song to turn the tide of battle.

**20级：科瑞隆领域每日威能 Corellon Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

For millennia, Corellon has fought with Gruumsh and Lolth. As your ambition takes you to the threshold of epic power, Corellon gives you a taste of the strength such ancient hatreds carry.

⟦无情恨意 Implacable Enmity⟧

**23级：科瑞隆领域遭遇威能 Corellon Domain Encounter Power**

Worship of Corellon means seeking to create beauty in all things, including the art of killing. You have it in your power to make an attack of such perfection that it blinds the target with awe.

⟦骇人注目 Awful to Behold⟧

**27级：科瑞隆领域遭遇威能 Corellon Domain Encounter Power**

Just as Corellon leads the other elven gods, you lead your friends. Just as Corellon uses his magic to protect and aid his exarchs, so too can you use his magic to harm foes for your allies' benefit.

title: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
body:
The ancient empire of Bael Turath forged one of the most well-known pacts with the devils of the Nine Hells. Within the labyrinthine system of codes, laws, and oaths that bind the devils into their rigid order, a number of secret loopholes and gaps exist that allow mortals to exploit the deal made by the tieflings' forefathers. And you are one of the hexblades who has learned to do so.

Devils harbor a particular hatred for infernal pact hexblades. The devils prefer worship and subservience, rather than the theft of their power.

**1级：炼狱契约奖励 Infernal Pact Reward**

With the power of the infernal pact, your vitality and endurance help fuel your spells.

**增益：**你在你的邪术师攻击威能和邪术师典范之道攻击威能的伤害骰上获得等同于你体质调整值的加值。5级时，此加值为2 + 你体质调整值；15级时，此加值为4 + 你体质调整值；25级时，此加值为6 + 你体质调整值。

9级时，你以⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤的生物也在伤害骰上获得此加值

**1级：炼狱契约之赐 Infernal Pact Boon**

Most hexblades bid some part of their enemies' souls to their patrons, but you have turned the laws of the hells against their masters. When you slay a foe, you claim its soul energy for yourself. Minor cuts and bruises disappear as you reap the benefits of your treachery. In the back of your mind you can hear the infernal lords cursing you and plotting your demise.

**增益：**你获得⟦灵魂盛宴 Soul Feast⟧威能

**1级：炼狱契约武器 Infernal Pact Weapon**

The origin of the blade of annihilation is not entirely known. Some believe that the powerful tiefling warlock who created the first infernal pact created the blade. Others believe that it is the remains of an ancient curse placed upon Asmodeus, lord of the Nine Hells, for his treachery in slaying the god remembered as He Who Was and rising to rule all devilkind. What is known is that although infernal pact hexblades are hated and loathed by devils, those hexblades bearing a blade of annihilation are met with even greater wrath. This might be due to the fact that some believe the blade is crafted from the essence of slain devils, and that their life force is what powers a hexblade's pact.

There might be some truth to the thought that the blade is a partially sentient being, for it seems to exult whenever it is used to defeat an enemy. With soul eater, you unlock the weapon's ability to drain a foe's life essence to empower your attacks. Blazing doom of the void stokes the weapon's bloodlust, causing flames to lick along its edge as it slices into your enemy. A hexblade wielding this weapon hears a faint roar in his or her mind with each strike, as if some faint, distant being seeks greater acts of bloodlust. Rumors also abound of hexblades who bore this weapon and fell into the service of evil, rising to become great champions of the hells.

湮灭之刃 Blade of Annihilation邪术师装备

This ebony sword seems to absorb the light around it. Motes of silvery light dance along its blade.

    **武器分类：**
    单手军用近战武器

    **武器组：**
    重刃

    **擅长加值：**
    +2

    **伤害：**
    1d12

⟦灵魂捕食者 Soul Eater⟧

⟦虚空燃炎 Blazing Doom of the Void⟧

**7级：炼狱契约武器惩戒 Infernal Pact Weapon Retribution**

When an enemy dares attack you, you lash out at it with your pact blade, leaving a wound of fire, which forces your foe away.

**增益：**你获得⟦反射地狱打击 Reflexive Hellstrike⟧威能

**9级：召唤邪术师盟友（炼狱契约） Summon Warlock's Ally (Infernal)**

Spined devils are some of the weakest of their kind, making their enforced fealty to you more offensive to them. They serve only out of terror, knowing the price your magic will extract from them for any rebellion, since a devil that fails to honor its summoner's demand is instantly annihilated. A summoned spined devil will shout oaths and threats at you, and this spell usually calls forth the same devil, allowing it to nurse a long-standing grudge. The spined devil lackey's death in the world does not destroy it if it died following your orders; instead, it is released back to the hells. Thus, a summoned devil enthusiastically follows suicidal orders.

When summoned into battle, a spined devil lackey rains its deadly quills upon your enemies. If an enemy moves too close to you, a quick mental command to it will make the devil launch a quill attack at your foe.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦刺魔侍从 Spined Devil Lackey⟧

⟦刺魔侍从 Spined Devil Lackey⟧

**11级：魔剑士行动（炼狱契约） Hexblade's Action (Infernal)**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

As you enter the paragon tier, you learn to master the infernal energy channeled to you through your pact. Your control is such that you can now direct that energy at an enemy, causing it searing pain.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在你回合结束前，下一个你的攻击命中或失手的敌人受到等同于5 + 你体质调整值的火焰伤害

**11级：炼狱契约面貌 Infernal Pact Aspect**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Your scaly skin and supernatural presence unsettle other creatures.

**增益：**你获得10点火焰抗力，且在威吓检定上获得+2加值。21级时，此抗力值为20。如果你已经有了10点或更高的火焰抗力（21级时20点或更高），则你的火焰抗力增加5点

**11级：炼狱契约诅咒 Infernal Pact Curse**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

With this spell, you weave hellfire into your enemy's soul. A smoldering flame erupts within its body, exploding out in jets of fire that sear nearby enemies.

⟦燃魂诅咒 Curse of the Fiery Soul⟧

**12级：炼狱契约祈祷 Infernal Pact Invocation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

The lords of the Nine Hells have no interest in aiding you. After all, you have used their own rules against them to steal their power. They prefer worship and service, not defiant robbery. When you use this power, the pact you forced upon them requires them to give you aid. However, this assistance comes at a price.

⟦炼狱祈祷 Infernal Invocation⟧

**16级：进阶炼狱契约之赐 Improved Infernal Pact Boon**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

As you consign your foes to oblivion, you extract raw arcane power from their passing. You have mastered this power to the point that you can now bring forth that energy in the form of a concussive burst that sweeps away your foes.

**增益：**当你使用⟦灵魂盛宴 Soul Feast⟧时，你同时可以推离每个邻近你的敌人1格

**20级：炼狱契约变形 Infernal Pact Transformation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

This audacious spell steals power from Asmodeus himself, seizing an iota of his raw energy and seeding it within you to fuel a dramatic transformation. Though such a small portion might not seem like much, it is enough to grant you the power to hew through your enemies. Asmodeus's wrath at your theft flows through this spell, turning you into a berserk warrior.

⟦炼狱变形 Infernal Transformation⟧

**25级：高阶召唤邪术师盟友（炼狱契约） Greater Summon Warlock's Ally (Infernal)**

Plucking a pit fiend from the battlefields of the Blood War and forcing it to serve you shows the height of both your power to summon devils and the insult you levy against the lords of the Nine Hells with each spell you cast. Although your magic is strong, it is not strong enough to force complete obedience from a pit fiend. Instead, you compel it to send a shadow of itself to your side, but a shadow that is still a fearsome enemy and a useful ally. It uses its flametouched mace to deliver scorching melee strikes, and its tail sting poisons enemies that linger too close to you.

The shadow of the pit fiend summoned in this manner takes note of your appearance, name, goals, and enemies, relaying it back to the original. Thereafter, your name is entered into the annals of the hells as an enemy of every devil.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦深狱炼魔仆人 Pit Fiend Servitor⟧

⟦深狱炼魔仆人 Pit Fiend Servitor⟧

title: 欧格玛领域 Oghma Domain
body:
关联神祇：（都是费伦神祇）欧格玛 Oghma，贡德 Gond

A devotee of Oghma comprehends the power of ideas and the primacy of information—not just with the mind, but with the soul. However, the lord of knowledge does not dedicate himself to knowledge alone. Innovation, inspiration, discovery—these too form the basis of faith in Oghma. To serve the Binder of What Is Known is to serve the truth, whether that truth is found in ancient secrets, beautiful art, or a brilliant invention.

**1级：欧格玛领域特性和威能 Oghma Domain Features and Powers**

Your studies and your devotion to Oghma grant you great insight into many topics. Allies blessed by Oghma's presence gain knowledge of how they might better their condition.

**增益：**当你进行基于智力的技能检定时，你可以使用感知来代替智力。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，在你下一回合结束前，爆发范围内的每个盟友在他的下一次豁免骰上获得+1加值

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your never-ending quest for knowledge drives you to discover the secrets of your foes. An enemy's weaknesses are often the most valuable information.

⟦学识祝福 Blessing of Knowledge⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Oghma shows his presence through a blue-green radiance and an eerie music that comforts allies but seems menacing to enemies of the faith. When you strike out and Oghma is with you, your weapon hums with those tones and flares into ominous brilliance.

⟦振鸣之击 Singing Strike⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

Insight isn't always gained through long contemplation. Sometimes an idea arrives like a flash of lightning.

⟦瞬时灵感 Sudden Inspiration⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

You owe it to your god to strike out against ignorance and those who would hide knowledge from the world. Thanks to his favor, you can imbue your weapon with the power to beat the truth into creatures that make themselves truth's enemy, filling their minds with ideas they don't want to hear.

⟦神智扰乱 Thought Twister⟧

**1级：引导神力（欧格玛领域） Channel Divinity (Oghma)**

Oghma exhorts his followers to find truth and seek new ideas, but the Binder of What Is Known also shares information with his faithful. When you call on his blessing, Oghma grants you and your allies the knowledge that lets you achieve your aims.

⟦传道授业 Knowledge to Spread⟧

**3级：欧格玛领域遭遇威能 Oghma Domain Encounter Power**

Your friends might not share your passion for seeking the truth at all costs, but everyone loves knowledge they can use. In combat, you share the blessing of your god so that a comrade might come to know the beauty of Oghma's way.

⟦致命鼓舞 Inspired Steel⟧

**5级：欧格玛领域特性 Oghma Domain Features**

You have learned how to treat all sorts of afflictions. When you bless an ally with healing, one such malady can also be washed away.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标能做一次豁免检定

**7级：欧格玛领域遭遇威能 Oghma Domain Encounter Power**

Knowledge is a blessing, but information can paralyze a foe. As you channel Oghma's power, your attack gives your enemy too much to think about.

⟦精神风暴 Thought Storm⟧

**10级：欧格玛领域特性 Oghma Domain Features**

As you gain experience in the ways of combat, you and your allies fall into a rhythm of strike and counterstrike. Your companions' attacks become the harmony to your own, and each battle creates its own song.

**增益：**当你使用带有心灵关键字的神术遭遇攻击威能时，此威能的每个目标提供战斗优势直到你下一回合结束

**11级：虔诚行动（欧格玛领域） Devout Action (Oghma)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Oghma favors inspiration and new ideas, on the battlefield as well as off. The move you make in a desperate situation inspires your allies to invent a new opportunity to gain victory.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你和离你5格内的每个盟友能以一个自由动作快步最多3格。

**11级：至高祝福（欧格玛领域） Transcendent Blessing (Oghma)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your connection with the Binder of What Is Known strengthens. The blue-green flames that reveal the presence of Oghma can leap from your weapon to bind your foe in place.

**增益：**当你以⟦振鸣之击 Singing Strike⟧命中时，此目标同时定身直到你下一回合结束

**12级：欧格玛领域辅助威能 Oghma Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Oghma rarely grants knowledge easily to those who seek it. Instead, he inspires and encourages the hunger for new truths. Oghma answers the needs of his most faithful with a mystical reminder to open one's eyes and mind, thereby gaining insight into the problems at hand.

⟦神圣启迪 Divine Inspiration⟧

**13级：欧格玛领域遭遇威能 Oghma Domain Encounter Power**

As a cleric of Oghma, you take it upon yourself to spread knowledge and educate others. As a warpriest of Oghma, you expect your enemies to learn their lessons the hard way.

⟦神智打击 Thought Crusher⟧

**16级：欧格玛领域特性 Oghma Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your knowledge of combat and of the capabilities of your allies allows you to inspire extra effort from them. With your aid, they draw on reserves of strength and resolve they might not have known they possessed.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标能以一个自由动作做一次基本攻击

**17级：欧格玛领域遭遇威能 Oghma Domain Encounter Power**

As one of the most powerful of Oghma's servants, you have honed your mind to be as sharp as any warrior's sword. Now, you turn your thoughts into weapons.

⟦真知灼见 Brilliant Idea⟧

**20级：欧格玛领域每日威能 Oghma Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

As you near the epic tier, you have come to understand that Oghma stands guardian over some knowledge that is too dangerous for mortal minds to comprehend. Now that you have proved yourself worthy in Oghma's eyes, your god allows you to use such dread knowledge as weapons.

⟦危险知识 Dangerous Knowledge⟧

**23级：欧格玛领域遭遇威能 Oghma Domain Encounter Power**

In battle, you can use your enemies as a conduit for unspoken communication with your allies, granting you a strategic advantage.

⟦落井下石 Shared Secrets⟧

**27级：欧格玛领域遭遇威能 Oghma Domain Encounter Power**

So that you might more closely rival his exarchs in prowess, Oghma grants you the ability to bore inside your foe's mind.

⟦神智摧毁 Thought Destroyer⟧

title: 欺诈者血统 Beguiler Bloodline
body:
Whether your curse of vampirism was inflicted by fate or by choice, you have come to wholly accept your power by the beginning of the paragon tier. However, though the common folk would call you a monster if they knew your true nature, you cannot simply forsake the memory of the person you once were.

You prefer the company of mortals and the benefits of being a part of society. Through the magic of blood and shadow, your mastery of your appearance and your subtle hunting methods have made you the most attractive of predators. Your enemies believe your lies even as they overlook your strangeness. When you reveal your true nature in all its dark glory, they are unable to look away—much less escape—as they fall to their knees before you.

**11级：欺诈者血统特性 Beguiler Bloodline Feature**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

Your cunning manner keeps your true nature and identity concealed from others, even as it helps you keep your foes off guard in combat.

**增益：**你在唬骗检定上获得+2加值。当你尝试对一个与你种族相同的特定个体使用的时，此加值增加为+5。此外，你能以一个次要动作进行一次唬骗检定来佯攻并获得战斗优势。你在对任何给你提供战斗优势的生物的伤害骰上获得+3加值

**12级：欺诈者血统辅助威能 Beguiler Bloodline Utility Power**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

The beguiling power of your blood can be released to charm your foes even in the heat of combat. As your dread curse draws the attention of your enemies, you and your allies gain the advantage.

⟦庄严灵气 Aura of Grandeur⟧

**16级：欺诈者血统特性 Beguiler Bloodline Feature**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

In whetting the power of your deadly attraction, you have also learned to shroud that power, escaping notice when it suits you. When you do so, the strength of your mind and spirit can cloak you even against the deadly light of the sun.

**增益：**你在隐秘检定上获得+2加值。如果你在进行此检定的回合内移动了不超过2格或你不在战斗中，则此加值增加为+4

另外，日光不再对你造成光耀伤害，且当它使你虚弱时，你在对抗此效果的豁免骰上获得等同于你魅力调整值的加值

**20级：欺诈者血统每日威能 Beguiler Bloodline Daily Power**

**吸血鬼贵族典范之道特性**

At the height of the paragon tier, you are a foe beyond compare. When you invoke the dark splendor of your hunter's instincts, your prey cannot hope to escape you.

⟦猎食光辉 Predatory Splendor⟧

title: 塞伦涅领域 Selûne Domain
body:
关联神祇：（都是费伦神祇）塞伦涅 Selûne

Selûne and her evil sister Shar created Abeir-Toril, and both were witness to the fission of reality that made their creation into two worlds. During the Spellplague, Shar's dark influence drove the catastrophe in which portions of both worlds swapped places, while Selûne was able to do little but watch from her spirit's home in the moon and weep. When the two sisters had clashed in the past, Selûne often took the heroic path of forgiveness, restraint, compassion, and self-sacrifice. That time has ended. Now, warpriests flock to Selûne's faith, and their task is clear. Light must battle darkness if it is to prevail.

**1级：塞伦涅领域特性和威能 Selûne Domain Features and Powers**

Her worshipers say that anywhere the full moon shines is a place for Selûne, but no roof, cave, or thicket is enough to shelter evil from the light of the deity's gaze. You consider it your duty to reveal hidden hatreds, quash unnatural desires, and bring her healing light to the shadows of the soul.

**增益：**你获得5点暗蚀抗力和5点光耀抗力。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，邻近此威能目标的每个敌人在它下一回合结束前的下一次伤害骰上受到-2减值。11级减值为-4，21级时减值为-6

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Creatures that commit evil acts might do so with fortune or dark skill on their side. To tip the scales in favor of good, Selûne offers her warpriests a measure of protection with her blessing of light.

⟦光明祝福 Blessing of Light⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Selûne smiles upon all whose bravery helps to oppose darkness and evil. With your weapon as her brand, your attack can shed her brilliance on your friends.

⟦月光印记 Brand of the Moon⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

For the most dedicated soldiers of her faith, Selûne's clear light is both a beacon and a weapon.

⟦月光武器 Moon Weapon⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

You can call on Selûne to direct your attacks against her enemies just as she illuminates the way on dark nights.

⟦启明殴击 Illuminating Blow⟧

**1级：引导神力（塞伦涅领域） Channel Divinity (Selûne)**

The servants of Shar utilize shadowy magic antithetical to life, while at the same time fearing the light. Channeling Selûne's power can allow a warpriest to take advantage of this weakness.

⟦生命与光 Life and Light⟧

**3级：塞伦涅领域遭遇威能 Selûne Domain Encounter Power**

Selûne's servants are known for their compassion, but such behavior is not your primary calling. When pressed in combat, you show what the face of Selûne looks like when the shadow of wrath passes across it.

⟦月影欧击 Moonshadow Blow⟧

**5级：塞伦涅领域特性 Selûne Domain Features**

Selûne is with your allies always, but when you call on her for healing, she sends a silvery radiance to protect those most wounded in the fight for right.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，爆发范围内的重伤盟友获得等同于你体质调整值的全伤害抗力，直到你下一回合结束

**7级：塞伦涅领域遭遇威能 Selûne Domain Encounter Power**

Selûne has set you on the path to war, but she will extend mercy to creatures that truly seek to turn away from hatred and evil. With peacemaker's light, you give your enemies a chance to reconsider the folly of working against Selûne's will.

⟦调停之光 Peacemaker's Light⟧

**10级：塞伦涅领域特性 Selûne Domain Features**

Now that you are at the apex of the heroic tier, you have the ability to revitalize any allies that are bathed in the glow of your attack.

**增益：**当你使用带有光耀关键字的神术遭遇攻击威能时，邻近此威能的任意一个被指定为目标的敌人的每个盟友获得等同于你体质调整值的临时生命值

**11级：虔诚行动（塞伦涅领域） Devout Action (Selûne)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

The servants of darkness seek to escape the light, but you can prevent their flight if you act with urgency.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在你的回合结束时邻近你的敌人迟缓且不能传送，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：至高祝福（塞伦涅领域） Transcendent Blessing (Selûne)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

You now stand among the most dedicated of Selûne's servants. With each blow that lands in your fight against darkness, you can grant hope.

**增益：**当你以⟦月光印记 Brand of the Moon⟧命中时，你或离你5格内的一个盟友可以做一次豁免检定

**12级：塞伦涅领域辅助威能 Selûne Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your connection to Selûne continues to grow. You feel her light becoming stronger within you, and on occasion you let it loose to confound enemies that stand nearby.

⟦缭乱之光 Dazzling Light⟧

**13级：塞伦涅领域遭遇威能 Selûne Domain Encounter Power**

Selûne's guiding light grows brighter to match the strength you bring to bear against your foes. When you strike in her name, you and an ally both feel her presence.

⟦银光欧击 Silverlight Blow⟧

**16级：塞伦涅领域特性 Selûne Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Selûne’s healing power now brings with it an interdiction against your enemies gaining succor.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，爆发范围内的敌人不能恢复生命值直到你下一回合结束

**17级：塞伦涅领域遭遇威能 Selûne Domain Encounter Power**

Selûne rewards courageousness, her favor settling around her heroes as a visible mantle of silvery light.

⟦闪烁打击 Gleaming Strike⟧

**20级：塞伦涅领域每日威能 Selûne Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Selûne rewards your continuing devotion by shedding a tear of joy that appears to you in a dream. With its beauty fixed in your mind, you can call forth a tear from Selûne to land among your foes like a falling star.

⟦天堂之泪 Heaven's Tear⟧

**23级：塞伦涅领域遭遇威能 Selûne Domain Encounter Power**

You feel the tug of Selûne upon your spirit like the moon upon the tides. In the heat of battle, you unleash waves of this same power to smite your foes.

⟦皓月之潮 Moon Tide⟧

**27级：塞伦涅领域遭遇威能 Selûne Domain Encounter Power**

You are now among the greatest of Selûne's servants, and her blessings flow to you freely. When you attack a dark soul, her light rewards all the bright souls present.

⟦错愕月读 Staggering Moonglow⟧

title: 闪电船 Lightning Skiff
body:
**闪电船 Lightning Skiff**

超巨型 载具

**生命值** 250；**空间** 2格×4格；**花费** 20,000gp

**AC** 5，**强韧** 20，**反射** 2

**免疫** 闪电

**速度** 飞行100

**驾驶员**

驾驶员必须站在控制轮前，通常是在闪电船的尾部

**工作人员**

除了驾驶员，闪电船还需要3个工作人员，他们所有人每轮都需要使用一个标准动作来帮助控制此载具。每少一个工作人员，此载具的速度就减少40。飞行速度为0时，则此载具失控飞行

**负载**

10个中型生物；1吨的货物

**失控**

失控的闪电船会以半速沿着闪电移动

**闪电龙骨**

闪电船是沿着闪电飞行的。它所驾乘的闪电无法对其驾驶员、工作人员和乘客造成伤害

title: 死灵学派 Necromancy School
body:
An ancient and reviled art, necromancy focuses on the ties between the body, soul, and animating spirit. Your spells can animate the dead, creating thralls to fight on your behalf; despoil an enemy's flesh with rot; or snuff out life with a whisper. Necromancy is a fearsome and grotesque pursuit, and only those of strong will and unwavering commitment can master its magic.

**1级：死灵学徒 Necromancy Apprentice**

**学徒级学派法师特性**

Death stalks your enemies and grants false life to you. You gain a short-lived resilience when you strike.

**增益：**当你以一个奥术死灵攻击威能命中至少一个目标时，你获得2点临时生命值

**5级：死灵专家 Necromancy Expert**

**专家级学派法师特性**

Extensive study into necromantic lore rewards you with unnatural vitality. You boast strength and endurance odd for someone of such sickly pallor or gaunt frame.

**增益：**你在运动检定和坚韧检定上获得+2加值

**10级：死灵大师 Necromancy Master**

**大师级学派法师特性**

Your concentration on necromantic power increases the potency of your necrotic attacks. They bite deeply, ignoring attempts to blunt them.

**增益：**你的奥术死灵攻击威能无视暗蚀抗力

**11级：死灵行动 Necromancy Action**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Your focus on necromancy spells lets you loose necrotic energy that unravels your foes' defenses.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，每个邻近你的敌人获得等同于你感知调整值的暗蚀易伤。如果敌人已有暗蚀易伤，则改为它被推离最多等同于你感知调整值的格子

**11级：死灵遭遇威能 Necromancy Encounter Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Author of many sinister necromantic tomes, Nulathoe had no compunctions against using corpses as undead thralls and then annihilating them in an arcane burst when they fell.

⟦努拉泽尔之震荡死亡术 Nulathoe's Concussive Demise⟧

**12级：死灵辅助威能 Necromancy Utility Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

A famed spell noted for preserving the dead from decay, Nulathoe's death ward girds creatures against eternity's cruel caress.

⟦努拉泽尔之死亡防护术 Nulathoe's Death Ward⟧

**20级：死灵每日威能 Necromancy Daily Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

With a single command, Nulathoe could draw forth the dead to swell the ranks of his vile army.

⟦努拉泽尔之不死军队术 Nulathoe's Undead Army⟧

title: 死亡领域 Death Domain
body:
关联神祇：鸦后 The Raven Queen

The living are allocated only a finite amount of time in the world, and creatures such as vampires, ghouls, and other undead violate this stricture and must be destroyed. The gods of death are the guardians of the balance between the living and the dead, marking the end of each life and seeing the fate that awaits all living creatures. The death domain grants you their power.

Clerics of the death domain are shunned as evil by mortals who fear death. However, the power of death is not evil in and of itself. By choosing to wield this power, you work to maintain the balance that death represents. You must hunt down undead creatures, oppose the evil of Orcus, and serve as an instrument of punishment for those that try to avoid death's hold over all living things. With the power of death at your disposal, your prayers mark your enemies for certain doom.

**1级：死亡领域特性和威能 Death Domain Features and Powers**

You seek out specific enemies of your faith—including those who mock death by delving into the darkest secrets of necromancy. As an emissary of death, you are the sworn foe of undead. Your power defends you against their foul energy, even as it grants you a measure of additional vitality with which to finish the fight.

Unlike many warpriests, you rely on your holy symbol to deliver your deadliest attacks, rather than on a weapon.

**增益：**你获得5点暗蚀抗力。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，你获得5点临时生命值。11级时10点临时生命值，21级时15点临时生命值

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your attacks carry the power of death, causing a subtle ripple in an enemy's fate that draws it closer to ruin.

⟦死亡阴影 Death's Shadow⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

This simple blessing carries with it the promise of your foe's defeat, scouring the enemy with divine shadow.

⟦幽暗之佑 Tenebrous Blessing⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

The shadows of death shift and swirl around you, granting you the supernatural ability to assess a foe's health in relation to your own.

⟦秃鹫之眼 Eye of the Vulture⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

All creatures are fated to die. Your role as an emissary of death lets you twist together fate and chance to ensure that your enemies feel the sting of death at your whim.

⟦劫数难逃 Inevitable Doom⟧

**1级：引导神力（死亡领域） Channel Divinity (Death)**

Your ability to channel the power of death lets you stave off the effects of injury when the need arises.

⟦阻止死亡之手 Stay the Hand of Death⟧

**3级：死亡领域遭遇威能 Death Domain Encounter Power**

Each time a creature falls in your presence, the energy of its death grants you a surge of power. When you invoke this prayer, your holy symbol flares to become a beacon of divine energy that you channel through friend and foe alike.

⟦死亡波涛 Death Surge⟧

**5级：死亡领域特性 Death Domain Features**

As a servant of death, you can turn an enemy's pain into the power of healing for you and your allies.

**增益：**当一个离你5格内的敌人生命值降至0时，你能以一个即时反应使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧

**7级：死亡领域遭遇威能 Death Domain Encounter Power**

Death is a part of the natural order, but the power to subvert that order is in your hands. By using raven's talon against a grievously wounded foe, you hope to let that enemy's demise heal the hurts of you and your allies.

⟦乌鸦之爪 Raven's Talon⟧

**10级：死亡领域特性 Death Domain Features**

The power of death flows around you like the swirling winds of an incoming storm. Those whose souls are only lightly tethered to their bodies can be swept away by your power, cast into the afterlife like leaves on the wind.

**增益：**在每个你的回合开始时，你能以一个自由动作对一个邻近的重伤敌人造成等同于你体质调整值的暗蚀伤害。

**11级：虔诚行动（死亡领域） Devout Action (Death)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

As a cleric of death, you are a gatekeeper charged with ensuring that those that seek to evade death cannot escape its clutches. To aid you in your task, the gods grant you the ability to find sustenance and strength in the pain you bring to your enemies.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点获得额外动作时，选择一个离你5格内的敌人。此敌人受到5点暗蚀伤害，且你或离你5格内的一个盟友恢复等同于5 + 你感知调整值的生命值。

**11级：至高祝福（死亡领域） Transcendent Blessing (Death)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Just as your enemies cannot deny the power of death, they cannot hope to deflect the holy energy that fuels your attack.

**增益：**当你的⟦死亡阴影 Death's Shadow⟧失手时，你在下次对此威能的目标的攻击骰上获得+2威能加值

**12级：死亡领域辅助威能 Death Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

At times, you can catch a faint glimpse of the fate that awaits each creature, hazy in your mind like a half-remembered dream. The first mystery that your insight unlocks, this power allows you to see how death binds all living things, and how you can twist those bonds to your allies' advantage.

⟦墓地束缚 Bound by the Grave⟧

**13级：死亡领域遭遇威能 Death Domain Encounter Power**

The creature you single out with this prayer gains a dark glimpse of the fate that death has in store for it. Leaving your enemy reeling, you set up your allies' follow-up attacks with a surge of power that can destroy even the strongest foe.

⟦暗影召来 Call to the Dark⟧

**16级：死亡领域特性 Death Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your familiarity with the afterlife weaves its way into your healing magic. As you ward death away from your allies, you direct its icy touch against your enemies.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，选择离你5格内的一个敌人。直到你下一回合结束，你的盟友对此敌人在伤害骰上获得等同于你体质调整值的威能加值。

**17级：死亡领域遭遇威能 Death Domain Encounter Power**

The demise of a foe inspires a stirring shout of victory, while a fallen comrade summons a deadly song of revenge. Whatever its source, you draw even greater power from the death that surrounds you on the battlefield.

⟦死之召唤 Death's Call⟧

**20级：死亡领域每日威能 Death Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

At the height of the paragon tier, the power of death shrouds you like a dark cloak. No foes can stand against you for long.

**23级：死亡领域遭遇威能 Death Domain Encounter Power**

As you enter the epic tier, you become an avatar of death. Your touch alone is enough to send a shrieking foe to the god of death's embrace.

⟦死亡之触 Death's Touch⟧

**27级：死亡领域遭遇威能 Death Domain Encounter Power**

The power of death cannot be denied for the foe that incites your wrath. As a herald of doom, you leave your enemy at the mercy of you and your allies, trapped by the knowledge that your next attack might be the last thing it ever sees.

⟦厄运通告 Herald of Inevitable Doom⟧

title: 塑能学派 Evocation School
body:
The evocation school of magic focuses on the most destructive expressions of arcane energy.

**1级：塑能学徒 Evocation Apprentice**

**学徒级学派法师特性**

Any mage can cast evocation spells to wield unmatched power on the battlefield. However, as a specialized apprentice, you learn how to wring all possible destructive power from your attacks.

**增益：**当你为一个奥术塑能威能掷伤害骰时，若任何骰子的结果为1，则选择其中一个重掷，并使用新结果

**5级：塑能专家 Evocation Expert**

**专家级学派法师特性**

The destructive power of your magic imbues you with an intensity that your enemies can sense. At the same time, your focus on the raw power of evocation enhances your stamina, making you tougher than those foes would ever suspect.

**增益：**你在坚韧检定和威吓检定上获得+2加值

**10级：塑能大师 Evocation Master**

**大师级学派法师特性**

Throughout the heroic tier, you have honed and shaped your mastery of evocation magic in battle after battle. Now, the energy imbued within your spells can overcome the defenses of even the most formidable foes.

**增益：**当你使用一个奥术塑能威能造成一种或多种特定类型的伤害时，你无视一个目标的相应类型的抗力。你不能无视免疫

**11级：塑能行动 Evocation Action**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Your mastery of evocation magic draws on barely controlled reserves of arcane energy. When you push yourself in combat, this energy flares to imbue your evocation spells with even deadlier power.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在此回合内下一个法师塑能威能的伤害骰上获得等同于你体质调整值的威能加值

**11级：塑能遭遇威能 Evocation Encounter Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

The wizard Kelgore's arcane knowledge was matched only by his unbounded rages. This spell is said to be the product of one such fit (prompted by a troublesome fey intent on teleporting away with Kelgore's spellbooks). Like magic missile, this spell hits with perfect accuracy, and it is favored by those who know they won't have the chance for a second shot.

⟦凯尔格之绝对火焰术 Kelgore's Undeniable Fire⟧

**12级：塑能辅助威能 Evocation Utility Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

Kelgore was a frail, scrawny specimen, making his fi ts of anger all the more comical. Disdainful of physical strength, he created this spell to trade vitality for pure arcane might.

⟦凯尔格之力量源泉术 Kelgore's Well of Power⟧

**20级：塑能每日威能 Evocation Daily Power**

**高深学派法师典范之道特性**

When Kelgore's wrath reached its peak, it touched off a rage that endured even after his most powerful spells were exhausted. In the aftermath, the foul-tempered wizard developed this spell, determined to unleash destruction that would last as long as his fury.

⟦凯尔格之火雨术 Kelgore's Rain of Fire⟧

title: 太阳领域 Sun Domain
body:
关联神祇：培罗 Pelor

The sun is the source of all life. Its warmth draws forth crops from freshly tilled fields. Its blinding radiance drives undead back to their crypts and holds the horrid monsters of the Underdark within their subterranean realm. The sun watches over the lands of humans, elves, dwarves, and halflings as sentinel, guardian, and provider.

**1级：太阳领域特性和威能 Sun Domain Features and Powers**

In forgotten dungeons, vast caverns, and secret temples, evil hides from the sun's redeeming light. You are bound to purify such places with your divine power. As part of your sworn duty to protect all that is good, you carry the sun's light into the endless darkness, smiting enemies while protecting those who fight at your side.

**增益：**你在死亡豁免检定上获得+2加值。离你5格内的盟友同样获得此加值。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，你或爆发范围内的一个盟友恢复2点生命值。11级时恢复4点，21级时恢复6点

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

As a warpriest, you can hold your own in combat with any fighter. However, your power extends beyond the damage you deal with your deadly weapon attack. Calling on the sun god to bless you in battle, you bolster yourself or an ally even as your foe is struck down.

⟦战斗祝福 Blessing of Battle⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Your allies might not share your faith, but from the day they joined you in your cause, the sun god's favor has shone on them. By evoking a subtle glowing brand above a companion, you mark him or her with the sun's saving power.

⟦太阳之剑 Brand of the Sun⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

Even in darkest night and far from the open air of the surface world, you can call on the power of the sun to light your way. Sun clerics use this power to shed their deity's light in places shrouded by darkness and evil.

⟦太阳之光 Sun's Glow⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

Although the sun is the source of life, its relentless heat destroys those who do not learn to respect it. When your weapon flares into a brilliant corona, you channel both aspects of the sun god's power.

⟦阳光爆发 Sun Burst⟧

**1级：引导神力（太阳领域） Channel Divinity (Sun)**

All healers know of the sun's ability to cleanse wounds and banish infection. When you channel the sun's divine power, you extend that healing potential to help shake off the worst effects of a deadly hazard or an enemy's attack.

⟦抚慰之光 Soothing Light⟧

**3级：太阳领域遭遇威能 Sun Domain Encounter Power**

When you first mastered this prayer, you felt the sun's protective light as a tangible force for the first time. The power sears your enemies and heals you or an ally.

⟦复苏日光 Resurgent Sun⟧

**5级：太阳领域特性 Sun Domain Features**

When you invoke divine power to mend wounds, a soothing radiance bathes those you aid. The glow restores physical health, and your touch bolsters the spirit, giving a companion the energy to fight on.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标获得等同于你体质调整值的临时生命值

**7级：太阳领域遭遇威能 Sun Domain Encounter Power**

The sun's radiance can blind those who are not wary of it. When a foe proves its worth by cutting through you and your allies, you let the sun's light take away its advantage. By placing a searing brand upon the foe's brow, you rob it of sight.

⟦灼热之剑 Searing Brand⟧

**10级：太阳领域特性 Sun Domain Features**

In battle, the sun's radiance wraps you like a cloak, making you a beacon of hope and defiance. The light you shed rattles your foes, making them easier for you to strike with the sun's might.

**增益：**当你使用带有光耀关键字的神术遭遇攻击威能时，你对此威能的目标具有战斗优势

**11级：虔诚行动（太阳领域） Devout Action (Sun)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

As you enter the paragon tier, the offensive power of your magic does not cause you to neglect your responsibility to your allies. When you push past your own limits in combat, the sun's power flows through you to soothe the injuries of your companions.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你（如果你重伤）和离你5格内的每个重伤盟友恢复等同于5 + 你感知调整值的生命值

**11级：至高祝福（太阳领域） Transcendent Blessing (Sun)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your increasing mastery of divine magic and your faith in the sun empowers even your most basic prayers.

**增益：**当你使用⟦太阳之剑 Brand of the Sun⟧时，在此豁免检定上获得+2威能加值

**12级：太阳领域辅助威能 Sun Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

It is said that the sun god's domicile is built of tangible walls of radiance, their beauty so great that enemies cannot bear to look upon them. Your skill with divine magic has grown to allow you to shape light as a reflection of your god's astral domain.

⟦光辉之墙 Wall of Radiance⟧

**13级：太阳领域遭遇威能 Sun Domain Encounter Power**

Your ability to channel the sun's power grows stronger as you ascend through the paragon tier. Your prayer of the rising sun builds on the knowledge that first fueled your sun burst power. This new power is a reflection of how you have grown in grace and favor in your god's eyes.

⟦旭日东升 Awakening Sun⟧

**16级：太阳领域特性 Sun Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Your healing word becomes infused with the power of the sun, causing the comrade you aid to momentarily shed a radiant glow. As that divine light washes over you and other allies, it grants a burst of vigor that helps all of you get back into the fight.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标获得等同于5 + 你体质调整值的临时生命值

**17级：太阳领域遭遇威能 Sun Domain Encounter Power**

As your power increases, you gain a greater ability to channel and control the energy of the sun. In the heat of combat, the sun's light shines to smite your enemies and strengthen your allies in equal measure.

⟦太阳之力 Strength of the Sun⟧

**20级：太阳领域每日威能 Sun Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

As you approach the epic tier, you are marked as one of the most passionate of the sun god's faithful. You alone can gaze upon the life-giving sun and not be blinded by its power. Your enemies are not so lucky.

⟦太阳耀斑 Solar Flare⟧

**23级：太阳领域遭遇威能 Sun Domain Encounter Power**

As a scion of the sun god, you channel power that blinds a foe you strike. If you are merciful, this attack might serve as a warning. If you are not, your blinded foe is unable to defend itself against your allies' attacks.

⟦绝世之光 Overwhelming Light⟧

**27级：太阳领域遭遇威能 Sun Domain Encounter Power**

In the final days of the Dawn War, the primordials sought to cast all the cosmos into darkness. For a time, all was obscured by shadow. As the battle reached its climax, the sun broke through, blazing in all its glory. Its gleaming light seared the primordials and delivered respite to the gods and their followers.

⟦黎明曙光 Light of the First Dawn⟧

title: 托姆领域 Torm Domain
body:
关联神祇：（都是费伦神祇）托姆 Torm，巴哈姆特 Bahamut，蓓伦妮·真银 Berronar Truesilver，加尔·闪金 Garl Glittergold，伊尔梅特 Ilmater

Duty, loyalty, truthfulness, perseverance in pursuit of what is right: All these qualities affirm your faith in Torm, the Loyal Fury. As a warpriest in his service, you stand as one of his holy champions, willing to seek justice in an unjust world, and acting with honor toward those who have none. You do these deeds not in search of reward from Torm, but because law and morality must be preserved.

**1级：托姆领域特性和威能 Torm Domain Features and Powers**

Torm is the lord of purest order—a god who sacrificed himself to destroy the tyrannical deity Bane and was born again, demonstrating the resilience of everlasting good against the most overwhelming evil. Torm's champions are dedicated to order and to each other. Even when you were a novice in the ways of Torm, you understood the value of friendship. Now a warpriest, you derive strength from such bonds, just as your allies rely on you for support.

**增益：**你在任何情况下都不会被强迫去攻击盟友。一次这样的尝试会自动失败，但强迫你攻击你盟友的效果附带的伤害和状态对你依旧生效。如果你愿意的话，你还是可以攻击盟友。

另外，当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能目标在所有防御上获得+2威能加值直到你下一回合结束

你同时获得下列威能

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Torm sacrificed his life during the Time of Troubles defending the laws of the gods. For his loyalty unto the last, he was resurrected. Righteous mortal laws can be hard to come by in a chaotic world, but the divine justice of Torm is available to all.

⟦律法祝福 Blessing of Law⟧

**领域随意威能 Domain At-Will Power**

Sometimes nothing is more valuable than an ally in the pursuit of righteousness. With Torm's blessing, you spread your enthusiasm for the cause by sharing his grace.

⟦护卫之击 Shielding Strike⟧

**领域辅助威能 Domain Utility Power**

Torm trusts your judgment—of your friends, of your enemies, and of what you believe to be just. For this reason, he conveys to you the power to allow a compatriot to strike true.

⟦克敌机先 True Strike⟧

**领域遭遇威能 Domain Encounter Power**

The teachings of a warpriest of Torm emphasize loyalty to one's friends and ideals, but allies should be deserving of that loyalty and act accordingly. With ringing blow, Torm rewards those who follow your leadership.

⟦振鸣欧击 Ringing Blow⟧

**1级：引导神力（托姆领域） Channel Divinity (Torm)**

Spur-of-the-moment tactics play as strong a role as long-term strategy in the battle for justice. Torm helps his most faithful win the day by letting them pull allies from across the battlefield as if they were chess pieces.

⟦上兵伐谋 Outmaneuver⟧

**3级：托姆领域遭遇威能 Torm Domain Encounter Power**

As you rise in the ranks of Torm's faithful, your actions inspire others to follow your example. None know this better than your companions at arms.

⟦振奋打击 Heartening Strike⟧

**5级：托姆领域特性 Torm Domain Features**

Your loyalty and your devotion to duty serves as an example. Those whom you heal can show their loyalty to you by coming to your side during times of peril.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，此威能的目标能传送到邻近你的一格

**7级：托姆领域遭遇威能 Torm Domain Encounter Power**

When you join an ally in melee, the divine power you channel can be the catalyst that rallies your companions' spirits.

⟦战术打击 Tactical Strike⟧

**10级：托姆领域特性 Torm Domain Features**

Your poise on the battlefield bolsters your allies' resolve and quickens their steps. When you strike, your companions leap to take advantage of a weakness in your foe's position that your attack revealed.

**增益：**当你使用神术遭遇攻击威能时，离你5格内的每个盟友能以一个自由动作快步1格

**11级：虔诚行动（托姆领域） Devout Action (Torm)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

When your need is most dire, Torm grants you and your allies a vision of your foes' positions, giving you tactical advantage.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，直到你下一回合结束，你和你的盟友攻击敌人时不受到由敌人的任何隐蔽带来的减值，且你和你的盟友知道离你10格内的敌人的位置，无视掩护和隐蔽。

**11级：至高祝福（托姆领域） Transcendent Blessing (Torm)**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Having entered the ranks of Torm's finest warriors, you gain a deeper sense of what it means to be loyal to your companions in the pursuit of what is right.

**增益：**当你以⟦护卫之击 Shielding Strike⟧命中时，邻近目标的每个盟友都获得在所有防御上的加值，直到你下一回合结束

**12级：托姆领域辅助威能 Torm Domain Utility Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

In the pursuit of righteousness, you serve not just as an exemplar but as a leader. As such, you must sometimes take command of the battle, using your knowledge of the field to assure that the righteous prevail no matter how mighty evil might be.

⟦重整部队 Rally the Troops⟧

**13级：托姆领域遭遇威能 Torm Domain Encounter Power**

Your faith in your deity lends confidence to your pursuit of righteous justice. As you select a target to strike down in Torm's name, your god signals approval of your choice with a peal of thunder that draws the attention of your allies to your cause.

⟦雷鸣欧击 Thunderous Blow⟧

**16级：托姆领域特性 Torm Domain Feature**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

Torm's grace shines on those whom you call friends. When your attention is required to heal a friend or yourself, Torm looks after your other companions.

**增益：**当你使用⟦治愈真言 Healing Word⟧时，爆发范围内的每个盟友能做一次豁免检定

**17级：托姆领域遭遇威能 Torm Domain Encounter Power**

In your quest to quash evil, you do not shy from standing in the forefront of a battle. You can even create such a situation by moving your allies out of harm's way.

⟦荣耀决斗 Honorable Challenge⟧

**20级：托姆领域每日威能 Torm Domain Daily Power**

**虔诚战争祭司典范之道特性**

You stand on the cusp of becoming one of the greatest heroes of Torm. Yet for all your heroism, you can be in only one place at a time—or so you thought before this boon was granted to you.

⟦调停封锁 Peacemaker's Interdiction⟧

**23级：托姆领域遭遇威能 Torm Domain Encounter Power**

When you knock a foe to the ground in the midst of a heated fight, you and your friends can take advantage of the resulting break in the action to regroup a bit.

⟦回春撞击 Revitalizing Shove⟧

**27级：托姆领域遭遇威能 Torm Domain Encounter Power**

You stand among the greatest heroes—not just of those who serve Torm, but of all history. When you lead an assault, others are compelled to action by the display of your valor.

⟦无畏冲锋 Valorous Charge⟧

title: 位面帆船 Planar Dromond
body:
**位面帆船 Planar Dromond**

超巨型 载具

**生命值** 500；**空间** 4格×10格；**花费** 1,125,000gp
