title: 牺牲美德 Virtue of Sacrifice
body:
A cavalier of sacrifice must be ready to give up anything—money, status, power, or life itself—to defend those too weak to shield themselves from evil. Cavaliers of sacrifice are renowned because of the hardships they endure for the good of others. You sleep in a stable while your allies rest in an inn, to save a few coins for the poor. You wear little more than simple, peasant's garb when not in armor and are an ascetic devoted to your cause, willing to endure any ill or pain to prevent others from suffering it.

Even though the virtue of sacrifice carries a heavy cost, you must temper your actions with humility. You give up so much, but that sacrifice does not make you more noble than others. Pride is your enemy, because it threatens to lead you to arrogance and ultimately disdain for those you protect. Cavaliers of sacrifice who fall to evil become even more villainous due to the great distance they tumble.

**阵营：**必须守序善良。牺牲美德对其信徒要求很多。只有最高尚的圣骑兵才会信奉它。

**1级：牺牲精神 Spirit of Sacrifice**

When you draw on your inner reserves, you can call upon the divine power of your virtue to instead grant that strength to an injured ally.

**增益：**你获得一个额外回复力。此外，你能以一个次要动作使用你的回气来医疗离你5格内的你选择的一个盟友。如果你这么做，那么你不会因使用回气而获得收益，但是该盟友恢复等同于他回复力值的生命值。

**1级：美德随意威能 Virtue At-Will Power**

In the hands of a cavalier of sacrifice, a weapon is more than a tool of destruction. It is a symbol of hope, because each strike you make against hope’s enemies shows your allies the path to victory.

**增益：**你获得⟦希望打击 Strike of Hope⟧威能

**7级：进阶正义之盾 Improved Righteous Shield**

The stronger you become in your conviction, the easier it becomes to protect your allies, which only further strengthens your conviction.

**增益：**当你使用你的⟦正义之盾 Righteous Shield⟧时，你受到的伤害减少10点。23级时，你受到的伤害减少20点。

**11级：牺牲行动 Sacrificial Action**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

When you reach for your deepest reserves of strength and will to push beyond normal limits, the power of your virtue flows freely through you. At those times, you can expend some of your vitality to let that power flow over your nearby allies, healing their wounds.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你能以一个自由动作同时花费一个回复力。这么做你不会恢复生命值，但离你5格内的每个盟友恢复等同于你的等级的生命值

**11级：牺牲信标 Beacon of Sacrifice**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

While the virtue of sacrifice requires you to focus on aiding those weaker than you, this power allows you to harm your enemies while following your virtue. You create a focused burst of radiant energy that sears your foes. As part of the power, you can also sacrifice some of your life energy to protect your allies.

⟦牺牲信标 Beacon of Sacrifice⟧

**12级：牺牲旗帜 Banner of Sacrifice**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

The banner of sacrifice is a sign of hope in the chaotic battlefield that draws your allies to it. As you stand and fight, the divine magic of this power transforms the pain of your wounds into soothing, healing magic for your allies.

⟦牺牲旗帜 Banner of Sacrifice⟧

**20级：牺牲责任 Burden of Sacrifice**

**英勇圣骑兵典范之道特性**

Pride and arrogance are both potential pitfalls for cavaliers of sacrifice, because this virtue carries a great demand that only a few can shoulder. You demonstrate the high price expected of you by giving your own vitality to restore the health of your allies.

⟦牺牲责任 Burden of Sacrifice⟧

**22级：共享牺牲 Shared Sacrifice**

The virtue of sacrifice, when shared among your allies, allows you to ensure that each of your foes' attacks harms only the strongest among you. You call upon divine favor, and a golden aura surrounds you, creating a shared pool of strength and vitality that your comrades can draw upon.

⟦共享牺牲 Shared Sacrifice⟧

title: 星辰契约 Star Pact
body:
The strange entities that associated with the stars have many names, but oddly, these names seem a constant across all languages and cultures that know them. Star hexblades learn the names in fevered dreams and waking delusions, and among them are the following: Hadar, Acamar, Gibbeth, Nihal, and Ulban. Each is associated with a particular light in the night sky, or in the position where a star should be. The powers and personalities associated with the stars differ according to the warlock who interacts with them, and their influence is often so subtle as to make star pact hexblades who detect it doubt their own thoughts and senses.

**1级：星辰契约奖励 Star Pact Reward**

As a star pact hexblade, you use your intellect and knowledge of the arcane to weave strength into your attacks, adding power to both your magical and physical attacks.

**增益：**你在你的邪术师威能和邪术师典范之道威能的伤害骰上获得等同于你智力调整值的加值。5级时，此加值为2 + 你智力调整值；15级时，此加值为4 + 你智力调整值；25级时，此加值为6 + 你智力调整值。

9级时，你以⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤的生物也在伤害骰上获得此加值

**1级：星辰契约之赐 Star Pact Boon**

They say a creature's fate is written in the stars, yet only star pact hexblades can fully comprehend how true that aphorism is. Doom begets doom, and death spirals inevitably toward more death. With the influence of Acamar, the Hungry Star, you use the death of one foe to tug at the web of fate and draw another enemy closer to the end.

**增益：**你获得⟦不祥之兆 Dire Fate⟧威能

**1级：星辰契约武器 Star Pact Weapon**

The secrets of the starshadow blade always find their way into the possession of a star pact hexblade through seeming coincidence and accidents of misfortune. When you call your pact weapon, it takes the form of a longsword formed of ghostly light and darkness. At times it glimmers with a baleful paleness and at others it appears surrounded by slithering tendrils of shadow visible only from the corner of the eye.

The entities you contact through the star pact exist as beings of unknowable minds associated with both the brilliance of stars and the cold silence of the dark between them. occupying a unique place both within and outside the cosmos, they sit astride the skeins of fate. Resplendent blade and wield the warp reveal these connections by giving you the power to create starbursts with sword strokes and to alter existence by shifting all in the universe but you and your foe.

星影之刃 Starshadow Blade邪术师装备

This longsword of shifting light and shadow appears as if someone made it by folding molten dreams and nightmares in the forge of a star.

    **武器分类：**
    单手军用近战武器

    **武器组：**
    重刃

    **擅长加值：**
    +3

    **伤害：**
    1d10

⟦光辉之刃 Resplendent Blade⟧

⟦挥舞扭曲 Wield the Warp⟧

**7级：星辰契约武器惩戒 Star Pact Weapon Retribution**

Star pact hexblades know Ihbar not by its light, but by its darkness. A blot of black in the sky that has slowly expanded over the centuries, Ihbar swallows traveling stars, cloaking their light as they enter it. Ihbar seems reluctant to release the wandering celestial bodies that enter it, because they take longer to cross Ihbar's darkness than other sectors of the sky. Star pact hexblades use the gaze into nothing power to grant foes a glimpse into Ihbar's darkness. For some the blindness provokes terror. A rare few have even gone mad.

**增益：**你获得⟦凝视虚无 Gaze into Nothing⟧威能

**9级：召唤邪术师盟友（星辰契约） Summon Warlock's Ally (Star)**

A presence enters the world in response to your call. A crack in the air opens to reveal a sucking void, and the struggling mass of an unseen thing emerges before the crack closes with a sound like skin tearing. You have summoned a thought phantom, one of the lesser spawn of the star entities. The thought phantom is slow but it stalks foes invisibly and seeks to crush their thoughts.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦沉思幽灵 Thought Phantom⟧

⟦沉思幽灵 Thought Phantom⟧

**11级：魔剑士行动（星辰契约） Hexblade's Action (Star)**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

With intense focus upon your arcane connection to the stars, you open a conduit to the thoughts of the star entities and foist their attentions upon your foe. By shielding your brain to even a glimpse of their intense minds, you save yourself from their staggering power.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在你回合结束前，下一个你的攻击命中或失手的敌人晕眩直到你下一回合结束

**11级：星辰契约面貌 Star Pact Aspect**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Your intense meditation on the beings that lurk beyond space and that link the planes gives you astonishing insight into the magic that flows through everything and steels your mind against the horrors of the knowledge you unearth.

**增益：**你在神秘检定上获得+2加值，且获得10点心灵抗力。20级时，此抗力值为20。如果你已经有了10点或更高（20级时，20点或更高）的心灵抗力，则你的心灵抗力增加5点

**11级：星辰契约诅咒 Star Pact Curse**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You've come to learn things forgotten by primordials and kept secret by gods. Your connection with the beings that provide that knowledge grants you protection against the dangers of knowing things that the universe wishes to remain unknown, but your enemies aren't so lucky. You open a foe to the insights of Khirad, the piercing blue star of insight and horror.

⟦禁断知识诅咒 Curse of Forbidden Knowledge⟧

**12级：星辰契约祈祷 Star Pact Invocation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You open your mind and body to the stars and become them. Your body transforms into radiance and void, and as you gain the perspective of the distant stars, you feel yourself becoming more detached from the reality you know. The star entities show little interest in the affairs of mortals, but as you siphon their power to do your will, you can't help but feel that something is watching—and drawing closer.

⟦星辰祈祷 Star Invocation⟧

**16级：进阶星辰契约之赐 Improved Star Pact Boon**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Your promise to the star entities offered them more than you realized, but it granted more power than you thought as well. Now that you understand what you have lost, you believe you would have made the same bargain, but perhaps your thoughts to the contrary were also bargained away. The death of a foe not only causes a hole in fate but an imbalance in space as well, allowing you to manage the motion of enemies like the Behemoth Star, Acamar, shifts the stars around it.

**增益：**当你使用⟦不祥之兆 Dire Fate⟧时，你可以选择离你2格内的一个敌人且滑动此敌人1格

**20级：星辰契约变形 Star Pact Transformation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

Calling upon the star entities to fulfill their enigmatic promise to you, you erupt into an ecstasy of light. Floating high above the battlefield, your radiance shines brighter than the sun. Allies can hardly bear to look upon your majesty, and enemies can be struck blind when they dare to face you.

⟦星辰变形 Starry Transformation⟧

**25级：高阶召唤邪术师盟友（星辰契约） Greater Summon Warlock's Ally (Star)**

A moment after your call, the soundless and weightless immensity of the way walker simply appears. Air feels drawn into the starry void that forms its roughly humanoid body. Around it sounds seem muted. light dims.
This being from the outer darkness serves the star entities, acting toward their unknowable ends in the voids between worlds and planes. Unused to existence in mortal space, the way walker is only half real. It passes through objects like a ghost, and it can grant you and your allies the power to walk with it in the spaces between existence and nothingness. Enemies who feel its touch aren't so lucky; their minds become open to the incredible disinterest the way walker feels toward all reality, and, for a moment, they lose the will to act or to live.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦道路行者 Way Walker⟧

⟦道路行者 Way Walker⟧

title: 星辰契约 Star Pact (Binder)
body:
The night sky of the mortal realm is an unfathomable deep filled with uncountable stars. In the dark between those stars lies the Far Realm, where dread creatures creep just beyond the reach of mortal senses and sanity. Older than all other parts of creation, these entities can be observed only as celestial patterns and signs. A binder of the star pact learns to manipulate those fell patterns, and to channel power no mortal creature was meant to know.

Star pact warlocks depend on Intelligence to master the dangerous knowledge they pursue. Any warlock can choose to take powers of the star pact that have levels, but binders have a special affinity for the madness and magic it represents. A binder gains additional benefit from some star pact powers, as noted in the power's description.

**1级：星辰契约之赐（缚影师） Star Pact Boon (Binder)**

Your connection to the mysterious Far Realm allows you to thwart the sight and senses of your enemies. You shroud a foe’s mind with a glimpse of the darkness beyond the stars.

**增益：**你获得⟦藏身学识 Hidden Lore⟧和⟦精神暗影 Mind Shadows⟧威能

**1级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

The power of the Far Realm lets you shape shadow in the likeness of the creatures that writhe beyond the void.

⟦暗影触手 Shadow Tentacles⟧

**3级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

By opening a small rent in the boundary between this world and the lightless void, you allow the horror of that darkness to wash across your enemies.

⟦虚空冲击 Void Blast⟧

**4级：星辰契约学识 Star Pact Lore**

Touched by knowledge that is not meant to be tasted by mortals, your mind opens to the power of the Far Realm.

**增益：**你获得5点心灵抗力，且在神秘检定和宗教检定上获得+2加值

**7级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

The eternal darkness that spreads between the stars is charged with deadly cold. By manipulating your power to form a black cyst of this nothingness, you freeze your foe from the inside out.

⟦黑暗囊肿 Cyst of Darkness⟧

**9级：缚影师盟友（星辰契约） Binder's Ally (Star)**

The soul eater is a strange creature spawned between the stars. It appears as an inky cloud of darkness from which emerge two gnarled claws. Feeding on the death energy of other creatures, the soul eater channels that energy to you in the heat of combat.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦噬魂者 Soul Eater⟧

⟦噬魂者 Soul Eater⟧

**11级：缚影师行动（星辰契约） Binder's Action (Star)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

Your mastery over the forces that dwell in the void makes your spontaneous attacks more potent.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在造成寒冰，暗蚀，或心灵伤害的伤害骰上获得+4加值。此加值持续到你此回合结束。

**11级：缚影师恩惠（星辰契约） Binder's Favor (Star)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

You can cast your foe's mind into a darkness that renders it more vulnerable to the realities of the physical world.

**增益：**当你以你的⟦精神暗影 Mind Shadows⟧命中时，所有对此威能的目标具有战斗优势的攻击都在伤害骰上获得+2威能加值，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

As you enter the paragon tier, you gain a deeper understanding of the terrors that lurk within the void. This dreaded spell casts a foe into the darkness for a brief second to overwhelm its body and mind.

⟦黑暗放逐 Banish to Darkness⟧

**13级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

The dark energy of the void has a hunger for all living things. When you summon that void to the battlefield, any creature that lingers too close pays the price.

⟦暗黑吞噬 Devouring Dark⟧

**16级：缚影师之赐（星辰契约） Binder's Boon (Star)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

Your alliance with the entities beyond the stars allows you to fade from reality, slipping toward nonexistence when you vanish from your foes' sight.

**增益：**当你使用你的⟦藏身学识 Hidden Lore⟧时，你可以同时成为虚体直到你下一回合结束

**17级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

You have spent your life strengthening your mind against the horrors of the Far Realm. Those who lack your discipline and training do not fare as well as you when the void presses in.

⟦高级虚空爆发 Greater Void Burst⟧

**23级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

This deadly spell can cripple even the strongest foe with searing pain, for no creature can withstand the power of the void for long.

⟦内在虚空 Inner Void⟧

**25级：高阶缚影师盟友（星辰契约） Greater Binder's Ally (Star)**

A doom hulk is a humanoid brute sculpted from the darkness between the stars, then bound by magic and granted limited sentience. It crushes its foes with its powerful fists, while those who remain too close to it quickly feel their life force drawn away.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦厄运巨物 Doom Hulk⟧

⟦厄运巨物 Doom Hulk⟧

**27级：星辰契约遭遇威能 Star Pact Encounter Power**

At the height of your pact’s power, you call forth the lifeless maw of the void. This dark energy tears at all creatures with the hunger of the faceless horrors that dwell within it.

⟦饥渴虚空 Hungry Void⟧

title: 阴暗契约 Gloom Pact
body:
You have made a bargain with the darkness, drawing on the power of the unseen masters of the Shadowfell and making that power your own. When you forged this pact, you sacrificed a portion of your own soul to whet your patron's appetite. From that point forward, each enemy that falls before you is drawn into the embrace of the dark power you serve.

The gloom pact grants you access to shadow power, which you weave into your arcane spells. Charisma is important to you, because your pact features and powers depend on it. Dexterity should be your second-highest score.

**1级：阴暗契约奖励 Gloom Pact Reward**

The darkness to which you pay homage grants you a surge of supernatural power that you can channel into your magical attacks.

**增益：**你在你的邪术师攻击威能和邪术师典范之道攻击威能的伤害骰上获得等同于你敏捷调整值的加值。5级时，此加值为2 + 你敏捷调整值；15级时，此加值为4 + 你敏捷调整值；25级时，此加值为6 + 你敏捷调整值。

9级时，你以⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤的生物也在伤害骰上获得此加值

**1级：阴暗契约之赐 Gloom Pact Boon**

The spirits of those you slay congregate around you, warped by shadow energy into wretched shells that are hungry for the life denied them. When you harvest an enemy's life force, you let it carry it into the shadow for a time.

**增益：**你获得⟦暗影集结 Convocation of Shadows⟧威能

**1级：阴暗契约武器 Gloom Pact Weapon**

The scourge of exquisite agony is the vile weapon of a torturer, and it can channel the shadow power of your pact against those who refuse to yield to you. An iron handle wrapped in stained leather, the scourge is set with nine steel chains each ending in a barbed hook. These tails move of their own volition, writhing in their eagerness to taste the flesh of your foes.

当你获得此武器时，你同时获得在持用该武器时能使用的2个威能，⟦皮开肉绽 Flesh Rend⟧和⟦精神剥离 Spirit Flay⟧

剧痛之鞭 Scourge of Exquisite Agony邪术师装备

The horrid tails hanging from this blackened flail writhe like steel serpents, their bite capable of rending armor, flesh, and bone.

    **武器分类：**
    单手军用近战武器

    **武器组：**
    连枷

    **擅长加值：**
    +2

    **伤害：**
    1d10

    **武器特性：**
    触及

⟦皮开肉绽 Flesh Rend⟧

⟦精神剥离 Spirit Flay⟧

**7级：阴暗契约武器惩戒 Gloom Pact Weapon Retribution**

Any enemy that dares to strike at you discovers that you are never defenseless when armed with your deadly scourge.

**增益：**你获得⟦暗影鞭笞 Shadow Scourge⟧威能

**9级：召唤邪术师盟友（阴暗契约） Summon Warlock's Ally (Gloom)**

The mysterious dark ones are a furtive, murderous lot, wicked and unnerving in their zeal for murder. As your servant, a dark creeper eagerly answers your call for the chance to target distracted enemies, slinking across the battlefield to help conceal you from your foes and plant its blade in an enemy's back.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦黑暗爬行者 Dark Creeper⟧

⟦黑暗爬行者 Dark Creeper⟧

**11级：魔剑士行动（阴暗契约） Hexblade's Action (Gloom)**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

The dark power behind your pact lends you the strength you need to push beyond your normal limits. By drinking deep of the power of shadow, you become something like a shadow yourself.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你成为虚体直到你下一回合结束

**11级：阴暗契约面貌 Gloom Pact Aspect**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

As the energy of the Shadowfell flows through you, the dark power of that realm grants you a measure of protection.

**增益：**你获得10点暗蚀抗力，且在隐秘检定上获得+2加值。如果你已经有了10点或更高的暗蚀抗力，则你的暗蚀抗力增加5点

**11级：阴暗契约诅咒 Gloom Pact Curse**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You maintain your pact through the destruction you wreak in battle. To aid in this harvest of souls, you master a dreadful spell that denies your enemy the ability to flee or fight back.

⟦衰老诅咒 Curse of Age⟧

**12级：阴暗契约祈祷 Gloom Pact Invocation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

You call on the power of shadow, but no one ever truly controls that power. The gloom that swirls around you can hide you from view. However, this same darkness can steal away your strength to leave you vulnerable to attack.

⟦黑暗祈祷 Dark Invocation⟧

**16级：进阶阴暗契约之赐 Improved Gloom Pact Boon**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

The spirit energy of your fallen enemies is twisted and corrupted by your increased dark power. When the time is right, you channel the rage of all those foes into a concerted attack.

**增益：**当你使用⟦暗影集结 Convocation of Shadows⟧时，在你下一回合结束前，你同时对你下一次攻击的单一目标获得战斗优势

**20级：阴暗契约变形 Gloom Pact Transformation**

**传说魔剑士典范之道特性**

By releasing the shadow that clouds your soul, you invest your physical form with dread magic. You become a creature of pure darkness—a malevolent wraith whose touch saps your enemies' strength and whose form is nearly impervious to attack.

⟦暗影变形 Shadow Transformation⟧

**25级：高阶召唤邪术师盟友（阴暗契约） Greater Summon Warlock's Ally (Gloom)**

The sorrowsworn owe allegiance to no master except perhaps the Raven Queen. Chasing after the misery and suffering on which they feast, these creatures act as dark emissaries of the Shadowfell, exacting vengeance on mortals that have circumvented the natural order, or battling the sinister forces at large in their native plane. Though you lack the power to truly master the sorrowsworn, you can draw on your gloom pact to give you temporary command of such a creature, which aids you until dismissed or destroyed to be re-formed in the darkness.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦哀誓魔 Sorrowsworn⟧

⟦哀誓魔 Sorrowsworn⟧

title: 阴暗契约 Gloom Pact (Binder)
body:
The gloom pact of the warlock draws on the power of creatures that dwell forever in gloom and shadow. Such arcane entities can be found in vast numbers in the Shadowfell. The masters of the gloom pact remain effectively unknown, even to those who serve them. However, many binders who forge this pact believe that they channel the power of the dark lords trapped in the Shadowfell. Locked in their prisons, these dark lords are beyond concern for how their power is used—making them perfect partners for the arcane might a binder seeks.

A good Dexterity score benefits a gloom pact warlock, since a subtle touch is necessary to properly command the power of void and shadow.

Any warlock can choose to take powers of the gloom pact that have levels, but the magic of the binder is specifically suited to the pact. A binder gains additional benefit from certain gloom pact powers, as noted in the power's description.

**1级：阴暗契约之赐（缚影师） Gloom Pact Boon (Binder)**

You have an aptitude for the shaping of shadow. The darkness that eddies around you on the battlefield responds to your command, carrying allies and enemies like dead leaves on the wind.

**增益：**你获得⟦回响挽歌 Echoing Dirge⟧和⟦暗影扭曲 Shadow Warp⟧威能

**1级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

Legends tell of a shadowy beast that dwells in the mist that borders and encases the domains of dread. The magic of the gloom pact gives this hound form and substance at your command, driving your foes from you in terror.

⟦暗兆猎犬 Hound of Dark Omen⟧

**3级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

You call on the power of shadow to extend your reach across the battlefield, crafting a swarm of clawed hands that surround and tear into your foe.

⟦乌木之爪 Ebon Claws⟧

**4级：阴暗契约学识 Gloom Pact Lore**

The secrets of shadow open your eyes and protect your body against the power of death.

**增益：**你获得黑暗视觉和5点暗蚀抗力。如果你已经有5点或更高的暗蚀抗力，则此抗力增加5点

**7级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

The dark energy of the Shadowfell spreads easily from a point of darkness you create. As your foe is stricken by the power of your spell, your other enemies are quickly drawn to share its suffering.

⟦黑暗棺罩 Pall of Darkness⟧

**9级：缚影师盟友（阴暗契约） Binder's Ally (Gloom)**

A shadow lurk is a creature born of a sliver of gloom and given the barest level of sentience. It flutters like a ghost, shrouding you as it lashes out through armor, flesh, and bone to claw at the spirit and soul within its target.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦暗影潜伏者 Shadow Lurk⟧

⟦暗影潜伏者 Shadow Lurk⟧

**11级：缚影师行动（阴暗契约） Binder's Action (Gloom)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

Your eyes become orbs of absolute darkness, allowing you to see the life energy flowing within your foes. With this sight, you can focus your attacks to increase your enemies' vulnerability.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来使用攻击威能时，你对此攻击的每个目标获得战斗优势

**11级：缚影师恩惠（阴暗契约） Binder's Favor (Gloom)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

With a gesture, you can use the fleeting energy of echoing dirge to affect another enemy.

**增益：**当你以你的⟦回响挽歌 Echoing Dirge⟧命中时，此冲击范围内一个额外的生物受到等同于你敏捷调整值的心灵伤害

**11级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

By leaching the light from the battlefield, you create an impenetrable cloud of darkness within which whispering shades and lurking shadows feast upon your foes.

⟦暗夜潮汐 Tide of Night⟧

**13级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

You turn a bit of coalesced shadow into a dread spectral beast that chills your foes to the bone.

⟦缠身暗影 Haunting Shadow⟧

**16级：缚影师之赐（阴暗契约） Binder's Boon (Gloom)**

**缚影大师典范之道特性**

The shadows that dance around you in combat can render those who ride them capable of moving through solid objects.

**增益：**当你使用你的⟦暗影扭曲 Shadow Warp⟧时，你可以滑动目标穿过敌人的空间和障碍地形。目标必须停在一个它可以正常占据的空间

**17级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

Many spells of shadow focus on animating and controlling a single shadow, but devouring tide takes the opposite approach. Uncountable shards of shadowstuff are spawned at your command, each possessing the hunger of the void.

⟦吞噬潮汐 Devouring Tide⟧

**23级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

Light and shadow destroy each other where they touch. By imbuing the power of darkness and radiance into your foe, you let the energy of that destruction consume it from the inside out.

⟦暗耀光辉 Umbral Radiance⟧

**25级：高阶缚影师盟友（阴暗契约） Greater Binder's Ally (Gloom)**

A gloom beast resembles an enormous hunting cat whose yellow eyes glare out from swirling, smoky darkness. Like a displacer beast, it has two whiplike tentacles emerging from its back, which attack with stinging cold that spreads numbness throughout the body.

**增益：**你能使用⟦召唤邪术师盟友 Summon Warlock's Ally⟧召唤一个⟦阴暗凶兽 Gloom Beast⟧

⟦阴暗凶兽 Gloom Beast⟧

**27级：阴暗契约遭遇威能 Gloom Pact Encounter Power**

As your command of shadow magic reaches its heights, you create a portal into a distant region of the Shadowfell. Lashing out at an enemy, you banish it from the battle for a key moment, even as its shadowy afterimage flails in rage and pain.

⟦幽暗置换 Umbral Swap⟧
